rawFindings.title: D-074 yarim bajarilgan: asosiy SSR so'rovlari x-ssr-key yubormaydi, shuning uchun eng ko'p ochiladigan sahifalar hali ham IP bo'yicha umumiy limitga tushadi
rawFindings.rootCause: ssrHeaders() faqat tryFetch (api.ts:89-91), lib/articles/api.ts:18-21 va fetchSalaryStats (apiExtra.ts:408-410) ichiga qo'shilgan. SSR loader'lar ishlatadigan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fetch() chaqiruvlariga qo'shilmagan: fetchVacancyPage, fetchVacancyFacets, fetchVacancyDetail, fetchSimilarVacancies, fetchCompanyPage, fetchCompanyDetail, fetchSimilarCompanies, fetchSupportContacts (lib/support/api.ts:13) va robots/sitemap proksisi (api/seo.js:92).
rawFindings.impact: Bosh sahifa, /vacancies, /vacancies/:slug, /companies va /companies/:slug SSR so'rovlari API'da hali ham req.ip kaliti bilan RATE_LIMIT_MAX=600/min bucket'iga tushadi (server.ts:167-168). Umumiy Vercel egress IP'dan daqiqasiga 600 dan ko'p so'rov (crawl yoki o'rtacha trafik) kelsa 429 qaytadi. Round 3 dagi seo-2/seo-3 o'zgarishidan keyin bu 429 SSR paytida render(503) ga aylanadi (vacancies/+data.ts:29, vacancies/@slug/+data.ts:32, index/+data.ts:28). Natijada foydalanuvchi va Googlebot asosiy sahifalarda 503 oladi. ISSUE-150 (P1) FIXED deb belgilangan, lekin web qismi faqat ikkinchi darajali fetch'larda ishlaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: api.ts:346 `res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/vacancies?${params}`, { signal: withServerTimeout(signal) });` — header yo'q. Xuddi shunday api.ts:366 (facets), :383 (detail), :397 (similar), :442-445 (companies, faqat Authorization), :490 (company detail), :506 (similar companies); support/api.ts:13 `fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, init)`; api/seo.js:92-94 faqat `accept` header. Taqqoslash uchun api.ts:89-91 tryFetch: `headers: { ...init?.headers, ...ssrHeaders() }`. API: server.ts:167 `keyGenerator: (req) => (isSsrRequest(req) ? "ssr" : req.ip)`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: ssrHeaders() ni lib/api.ts dagi barcha SSR'da ishlaydigan fetch'larga (yoki bitta umumiy serverFetch yordamchisiga) qo'shish: fetchVacancyPage, fetchVacancyFacets, fetchVacancyDetail, fetchSimilarVacancies, fetchCompanyPage (Authorization bilan birlashtirib), fetchCompanyDetail, fetchSimilarCompanies, lib/support/api.ts request() va api/seo.js dagi upstream fetch. Web unit-check'ga SSR rejimida bu funksiyalar x-ssr-key yuborishini tekshiradigan test qo'shish. apps/web/.env.example ga SSR_API_KEY izohini qo'shish.

rawFindings.title: Web CSP dagi object-src 'none' blob: PDF rezyumeni Chrome/Edge PDF ko'ruvchisida bloklashi mumkin (D-057 va D-058 bir-biriga zid)
rawFindings.rootCause: D-058 bo'yicha rezyume fetch bilan olinadi va ilova origin'ida yaratilgan blob: URL ga yangi oynada o'tiladi (resume.ts:53, 74-75). blob: hujjati uni yaratgan sahifaning policy container'ini (CSP) meros oladi, u yerda esa `object-src 'none'` bor. Chromium to'liq sahifali PDF'ni plagin (embed) sifatida ochadi va object-src tekshiruviga bo'ysundiradi. API jamoasi aynan shu sabab bilan API CSP'da `objectSrc: ['self']` qoldirgan (server.ts:126-127), web siyosatida esa bu hisobga olinmagan. 'self' ham blob: sxemasiga mos kelmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Chrome/Edge'da nomzod o'z PDF rezyumesini, ish beruvchi esa nomzodning PDF'ini ochganda yangi oyna kulrang yoki bo'sh bo'lib qolishi mumkin. UI xato ko'rsatmaydi, chunki fetch muvaffaqiyatli. Brauzer regressiyasi o'tkazilmagan: wave1 test kutilmalarida bu xavf ochiq deb yozilgan, ui_regression_final.log esa bo'sh. Ish beruvchi uchun asosiy oqim (nomzod CV'si) buziladi.
rawFindings.evidence: +headersResponse.ts:52 `directive("object-src", "'none'")`; resume.ts:53 `const tab = window.open("", "_blank");`, :74-75 `const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob); if (tab) tab.location.replace(objectUrl);`; apps/api/src/server.ts:126-127 `// Brauzerning o'z PDF ko'ruvchisi uchun ... objectSrc: ["'self'"]`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Web siyosatida object-src ni `blob:` ga o'zgartirish. Faqat sahifa skripti o'zi yaratgan blob'lar ruxsat oladi, tashqi plagin manbalari yopiq qoladi. Keyin Chrome, Edge, Firefox va Safari'da ikkala tugmani (ResumeFile va employer ApplicationDetail) konsolda CSP xatosi yo'qligini tekshirib sinash. Muqobil yo'l: inline ko'rish o'rniga doim yuklab olish (a.download) ishlatish.

rawFindings.title: /uploads/*.pdf blokini absolute-form so'rov (GET http://host/uploads/resume-<hex>.pdf) chetlab o'tadi
rawFindings.rootCause: onRequest bloki yo'lni xom req.url dan oladi va `/uploads/` bilan boshlanishini talab qiladi (server.ts:194-200). find-my-way 8.2.2 esa '/' bilan boshlanmaydigan URL'dan `https?://host/` qismini kesib, uni /uploads/* marshrutiga yo'naltiradi (find-my-way/index.js:560-562). @fastify/static faylni routerning req.params['*'] qiymati bo'yicha beradi (@fastify/static/index.js:119). Node va Fastify absolute-form so'rovni rad etmaydi. onSend (isUploadsRequest) routeOptions.url ni tekshiradi, lekin onRequest bloki tekshirmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Rezyume fayl nomini biladigan kishi API'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yetib borsa (dev/e2e, port ochiq self-hosted yoki Docker, request-target'ni origin-form'ga keltirmaydigan proksi), PDF'ni avtorizatsiyasiz yuklab oladi. Bu D-058 ning asosiy maqsadini buzadi: URL'ni bilish kirish huquqi bo'lmasligi kerak edi. resumeUrl ilgari ish beruvchilarga yuborilgan, loglarda va egasining javobida hanuz bor. .part vaqtinchalik fayllar ham shu yo'l bilan ochiladi. Railway edge request-target'ni normallashtirsa, production'da ekspluatatsiya qilish qiyinroq. e2e variantlari ro'yxatida (e2e-check.mjs:2128-2135) bu holat yo'q.
rawFindings.evidence: server.ts:194 `let path = req.url.split(/[?#;]/, 1)[0];` ... :200 `return path.toLowerCase().startsWith("/uploads/") ? path : null;` va :225-226 `const pathname = uploadsPathname(req); if (!pathname) return;`. find-my-way/index.js:560-562 `if (path.charCodeAt(0) !== 47) { path = path.replace(FULL_PATH_REGEXP, '/') }`. fastify/lib/request.js:155-158 `url` getter `this.raw.url` qaytaradi. @fastify/static/index.js:119 `pumpSendToReply(req, reply, '/' + req.params['*'], ...)`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: onRequest ichida qarorni router natijasidan chiqarish: `req.routeOptions.url === "/uploads/*"` bo'lsa `(req.params as Record<string,string>)["*"]` (static aynan shu qiymatni beradi) bo'yicha resume-/demo-resume-/.pdf/.part/nuqta qoidalarini qo'llash. Qo'shimcha ravishda '/' bilan boshlanmaydigan req.raw.url ni 400 bilan rad etish. e2e variantlari ro'yxatiga raw socket orqali absolute-form so'rovni qo'shish.

rawFindings.title: Maqola muqovasi va matn ichidagi tashqi https rasmlar yangi CSP img-src tomonidan bloklanadi, API va adapter ularni hanuz qabul qiladi
rawFindings.rootCause: D-057 siyosatida img-src faqat 'self' data: blob:, API origin va *.googleusercontent.com ga ruxsat beradi. API esa COVER_URL_RE da istalgan https rasmni muqova sifatida qabul qiladi (articles.content.ts:35). Web adapter va markdown renderer ham istalgan https:// rasmni ga qo'yadi (articles/adapter.ts:81, articles/content.ts:58).
rawFindings.impact: Admin yoki muallif maqolaga tashqi https muqova yoki ![...](https://...) rasm qo'shsa, u ochiq maqola sahifasida va admin preview'da siniq rasm bo'lib chiqadi. Faqat konsolda CSP xatosi ko'rinadi. Round 3 gacha (CSP yo'q paytda) bu rasmlar ishlardi.
rawFindings.evidence: +headersResponse.ts:46 `directive("img-src", "'self'", "data:", "blob:", API_ORIGIN, GOOGLE_AVATARS)`; articles.content.ts:35 `COVER_URL_RE = /^(\/uploads\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+|https:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+)$/`; content.ts:58 `if (/^https:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+$/i.test(url)) return url;`; adapter.ts:81 xuddi shu qoida.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Bitta qoida tanlash. Tavsiya: tashqi rasmlarni API'da (COVER_URL_RE va kontent validatsiyasi) va web'da (safeImageSrc, articleCoverUrl) rad etib, faqat /uploads/ ga ruxsat berish. Bu uchinchi tomon kuzatuv piksellarini ham yopadi. Muqobil: img-src ga aniq ruxsat etilgan hostlarni qo'shish (https: ni butunlay ochmaslik).

rawFindings.title: Web CSP keragidan kengroq: script-src butun accounts.google.com origin'iga ruxsat beradi, default-src va hisobot yo'q
rawFindings.rootCause: GOOGLE = "https://accounts.google.com" script-src, connect-src va frame-src ga yo'lsiz qo'shilgan. GIS uchun faqat /gsi/client skripti va /gsi/ yo'llari kerak. accounts.google.com CSP Evaluator ro'yxatida JSONP chetlab o'tish hosti sifatida belgilangan (/o/oauth2/revoke?callback=). Siyosatda default-src yo'q, shuning uchun sanab o'tilmagan direktivalar (masalan media-src) cheklanmagan. report-to/report-uri ham yo'q.
rawFindings.impact: HTML in'eksiyasi bo'lsa, hujumchi nonce'siz ham accounts.google.com dagi JSONP endpoint orqali skript ishga tushirishi mumkin, ya'ni nonce himoyasi zaiflashadi. Production'dagi CSP buzilishlari ko'rinmaydi. Mustaqil ekspluatatsiya emas, qattiqlashtirish masalasi.
rawFindings.evidence: +headersResponse.ts:30 `const GOOGLE = "https://accounts.google.com";`, :42 `directive("script-src", "'self'", `'nonce-${nonce}'`, GOOGLE)`, :48 connect-src va :49 frame-src ham GOOGLE; :39-56 ro'yxatida default-src yo'q. SocialLogin.tsx:77 faqat `https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client` yuklaydi.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: script-src ga `https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client`, connect-src va frame-src ga `https://accounts.google.com/gsi/` qo'yish (Google GIS hujjatidagi qiymatlar). `default-src 'self'` (yoki kamida `media-src 'none'`) qo'shish. Ixtiyoriy ravishda report-to endpoint qo'shish.

rawFindings.title: Log redaksiyasidagi /api/auth/recovery/<x>/<y> qoidasi hech qanday sirni yashirmaydi, faqat haqiqiy marshrut nomini buzadi
rawFindings.rootCause: Barcha tiklash marshrutlari tokenni POST tanasida oladi (recovery.routes.ts:54-196), yo'lda sir yo'q. Shunga qaramay regex ikkinchi segmentni almashtiradi.
rawFindings.impact: Loglarda /api/auth/recovery/manual/status va /api/auth/recovery/manual/continue ikkalasi ham /api/auth/recovery/manual/[redacted] bo'lib yoziladi. Xavfsizlik hodisasini tekshirishda qaysi endpoint chaqirilgani (holat so'rovi yoki Telegram havolasi olish) farqlanmaydi. Wave1 reviewer topgan, tuzatilmagan.
rawFindings.evidence: server.ts:67 `.replace(/(\/api\/auth\/recovery\/[a-z-]+\/)[^/?#]+/i, "$1[redacted]")`; recovery.routes.ts:182 `app.post("/api/auth/recovery/manual/status", ...)`, :196 `app.post("/api/auth/recovery/manual/continue", ...)`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Bu qoidani olib tashlash yoki uni kelajakda yo'lda token oladigan aniq marshrut nomlari bilan cheklash. Staff taklifi va query parametrlari qoidalari saqlanadi.

rawFindings.title: TRUST_PROXY bo'sh qiymat berilsa jimgina `true` bo'ladi — D-053 yopgan soxtalashtiriladigan rejim qaytadi
rawFindings.rootCause: D-053 faqat sukut qiymatini ("1") o'zgartirgan. Transform esa bo'sh satrni avvalgidek `true` ga aylantiradi. `.default("1")` faqat o'zgaruvchi umuman yo'q bo'lganda ishlaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Railway Variables yoki .env da `TRUST_PROXY=` (bo'sh) qolsa, Fastify X-Forwarded-For ning eng chap (mijoz yozgan) qiymatini oladi. Barcha IP limitlari (login lockout email|ip, tiklash kvotalari, umumiy 600/min) soxta sarlavha bilan chetlab o'tiladi. Startup log `TRUST_PROXY = true` ni ko'rsatadi, lekin xato yoki ogohlantirish chiqmaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: env.ts:120-130 `.default("1").transform((v) => { const s = v.trim().toLowerCase(); if (s === "" || s === "true") return true; ...`
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Bo'sh satrni sukut "1" deb talqin qilish (yoki env xatosi berish). Production'da `true` qiymati uchun startup ogohlantirishi qo'shish.

rawFindings.title: README hali ham API CSP WEB_ORIGIN dan olinadi deydi — Round 3 dan keyin bu kodga zid
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 da API CSP `default-src 'none'` ga o'tdi va endi allowedOrigins yoki WEB_ORIGIN dan foydalanmaydi (server.ts:122-134). Web CSP esa build paytidagi VITE_API_URL dan quriladi (+headersResponse.ts:14). README jumlasi yangilanmagan.
rawFindings.impact: Self-hosted operator CSP ni WEB_ORIGIN orqali sozlanadi deb o'ylaydi. Aslida API domeni o'zgarsa web'ni qayta build qilish kerak (connect-src/img-src build'ga yozilgan). Aks holda brauzer API va WebSocket so'rovlarini jimgina bloklaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: README.md:248-249 `Reverse-proxy (nginx/caddy) ortiga qo'ysangiz, HTTPS va WEB_ORIGIN ni haqiqiy domenga moslang — apps/api CORS va CSP shundan oladi.`; server.ts:125-130 statik direktivalar; +headersResponse.ts:14 `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Jumlani tuzatish: WEB_ORIGIN faqat CORS uchun; web CSP (connect-src/img-src) build paytidagi VITE_API_URL dan quriladi, API domeni o'zgarsa web qayta build qilinadi. Xavfsizlik paragrafiga web nonce CSP ni qo'shish.

rawFindings.title: Self-hosted web server `trustProxy: true` bilan mijoz yozgan X-Forwarded-For/Proto ga ishonadi
rawFindings.rootCause: D-053 faqat API'ga qo'llangan. Web server hali ham barcha hop'larga ishonadi.
rawFindings.impact: Log'dagi remoteAddress (server/index.mjs:106) mijoz tomonidan soxtalashtiriladi, bu hodisani tekshirishni chalg'itadi. req.protocol ham soxta X-Forwarded-Proto ga bog'liq (HSTS qarori, :125). Web serverda IP limit yo'qligi uchun ta'sir kichik.
rawFindings.evidence: server/index.mjs:112 `trustProxy: true,`; :106 `remoteAddress: request.ip`; :125 `if (req.protocol === "https") reply.header("Strict-Transport-Security", HSTS);`
rawFindings.recommendedFix: API bilan bir xil qoidani qo'llash: `trustProxy` ni env'dan olish, sukut 1 hop. README'da self-hosted uchun ko'rsatma berish.

rawFindings.title: Himoyalangan PDF ochilayotgan oynadagi yuklanish matni qattiq yozilgan o'zbekcha (i18n yo'q)
rawFindings.rootCause: openProtectedFile yangi oynaga lug'atdan emas, qattiq yozilgan HTML satrni yozadi. Hujjatda lang atributi yo'q.
rawFindings.impact: ru/en foydalanuvchilar PDF yuklanguncha 'Yuklanmoqda…' matnini ko'radi. Ekran o'quvchi tilni noto'g'ri aniqlaydi.
rawFindings.evidence:
resume.ts:56 `tab.document.write("PDF

Yuklanmoqda…

");`
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Matnni chaqiruvchidan parametr sifatida (t.* lug'at kaliti) olish va `<html lang=...>` qo'yish. Uch tilga kalit qo'shish.

rawFindings.title: hreflang va x-default query parametrlarini tashlaydi: canonical, sitemap va hreflang bir-biriga zid
rawFindings.rootCause: seo-4 fix'i tekshirilgan parametrlarni faqat sahifa +Head'laridagi `canonical` ga uzatdi. hreflang va x-default esa faqat HeadDefault'da chiqadi, u `useHead()` ni parametrsiz chaqiradi. Sahifa Head'larida parametr bilan hisoblangan `alternates` hech qayerda ishlatilmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: /salaries?category=it sahifasining canonical'i o'ziga qaraydi, lekin hreflang uz/ru/en va x-default /salaries, /ru/salaries, /en/salaries ga qaraydi. sitemap-static.xml esa shu URL uchun /ru/salaries?category=it ni alternate deb e'lon qiladi. /vacancies?page=2 o'zining til alternativlari sifatida 1-sahifani ko'rsatadi. hreflang'da o'ziga havola ham, qaytuvchi havola ham yo'q, shuning uchun Google uni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi. Wave1'dagi "the same params go into the hreflang alternates" da'vosi noto'g'ri.
rawFindings.evidence: HeadDefault.tsx:34 `const { alternates, xDefault, locale } = useHead();` (parametrsiz), :59-63 alternates/x-default chiqariladi; lib/i18n/head.ts:48-54 `search` faqat berilgan params'dan; vacancies/+Head.tsx:19-23 va salaries/+Head.tsx:16-20 useHead({...}) dan faqat `canonical` olinadi; api seo.routes.ts:125-128 `/salaries?category=${c.slug}` va :219-222 alternates `PUBLIC_ORIGIN + loc(lc, path)` (query bilan); Footer.tsx:16,169 til havolalari query'ni saqlaydi. Butun web'da `hrefLang` faqat HeadDefault.tsx:61,63 da chiqadi.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: hreflang va x-default'ni canonical bilan bir xil whitelist parametrlardan quring. Ikki yo'l bor: sahifa +Head'lari alternates'ni o'zi chiqarsin va HeadDefault ularni o'tkazib yuborsin, yoki har marshrut uchun umumiy canonicalParams(pageContext) yordamchisi yozilsin va HeadDefault ham undan foydalansin. /salaries?category=… uchun HTML hreflang sitemap bilan bayt-ba-bayt mos kelishini unit test bilan tekshiring.

rawFindings.title: Endi alohida canonical olgan filtrlangan va sahifalangan URL'larning title va description'i bir xil
rawFindings.rootCause: seo-4 canonical'ga category, region, role va page ni qo'shdi, shuning uchun bu URL'lar endi mustaqil indekslanadigan sahifalar. Lekin title va description hamon query'dan qat'i nazar umumiy lug'at matnidan olinadi.
rawFindings.impact: Sitemap e'lon qilgan barcha /salaries?category=… va /salaries?region=… URL'larining (kategoriya va hudud soniga teng) <title>'i "Maosh statistikasi — ISH BOR!", description'i ham bir xil. /vacancies?category=it, ?region=…, ?page=N sahifalarining sarlavhasi "Vakansiyalar — O'zbekiston bo'ylab ish o'rinlari". /companies?industry=… va /articles?category=… da ham shunday. Google bularni dublikat deb biladi va o'zi canonical tanlaydi. seo-4 maqsadi (kasb va hudud bo'yicha maosh sahifalarining reytingi) amalga oshmaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: salaries/+Head.tsx:22-27 har doim `t.metaExtra.salaries.title/description`; salaries/+title.ts:4 bir xil; vacancies/+Head.tsx:31-32 `const meta = q ? t.meta.searchQuery(q) : t.meta.searchAll;`; vacancies/+title.ts:6-8; companies/+Head.tsx:23-26 `t.meta.companies`; articles/index/+Head.tsx:34 `t.meta.articles`; seo.routes.ts:125-128 query'li maosh URL'lari sitemap'da.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Title va description'ni tekshirilgan parametrlardan uch tilda quring: kategoriya, hudud va kasb nomi hamda sahifa raqami (masalan "Frontend dasturchi maoshi — Toshkent | ISH BOR!", "IT vakansiyalari — 2-sahifa"). Buning uchun +title.ts va +Head.tsx bir xil funksiyadan foydalansin. Nom API'dan kelmasa slug bo'yicha lug'atdan olinsin.

rawFindings.title: D-074 SSR kaliti asosiy crawl fetcher'larida yo'q: yangi 503 oqimi bilan 429 endi sahifani 503 qiladi
rawFindings.rootCause: `ssrHeaders()` faqat tryFetch'ga (api.ts:91), articles/api.ts va fetchSalaryStats'ga qo'shilgan. Ro'yxat, detail va bosh sahifa ishlatadigan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri `fetch` chaqiruvlari `x-ssr-key` yubormaydi. Wave1 reviewer buni YOQ deb belgilagan, wave2 ham tuzatmagan.
rawFindings.impact: Vercel'dagi SSR trafigi umumiy IP bucket'iga tushadi (RATE_LIMIT_MAX 600/min). Crawl yoki cho'qqi paytida API 429 qaytaradi. fetchVacancyPage, Detail, CompanyPage va CompanyDetail buni ApiError deb uloqtiradi, Round 3'dagi yangi `throw render(503)` esa bosh sahifa, /vacancies, /vacancies/:slug, /companies va /companies/:slug ni foydalanuvchi va Googlebot uchun 503 qiladi. DEPLOY.md:80 dagi "SSR so'rovlari … 429 bo'lmaydi" va'dasi kodga zid.
rawFindings.evidence: api.ts:346 `fetch(`${API_URL}/api/vacancies?${params}`, { signal: withServerTimeout(signal) })`; :366 facets, :383 detail, :397 similar, :440-444 fetchCompanyPage (headers faqat Authorization), :490 company detail, :506 similar companies — hech birida ssrHeaders() yo'q; vacancies/@slug/+data.ts:25,32 va index/+data.ts:18-28 ApiError→render(503); api server.ts:167-168 `keyGenerator: isSsrRequest(req) ? "ssr" : req.ip`; api/seo.js:92-95 robots/sitemap proxy ham kalitsiz.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Yettala fetcher'ga va api/seo.js'ga `headers: { ...ssrHeaders(), ...(token ? { Authorization } : {}) }` qo'shing. +data'da 429 ni alohida ko'rib chiqish (masalan qisqa qayta urinish) ham mumkin. Build'dan keyin SSR so'rovi `x-ssr-key` bilan ketishini tekshiring.

rawFindings.title: Mijoz yuborgan noto'g'ri URL parametrlari SSR'da 503 beradi (client xatosi uchun 5xx)
rawFindings.rootCause: +data barcha ApiError'larni, jumladan 400 VALIDATION_ERROR'ni ham, "API ishlamayapti" deb qabul qilib render(503) qiladi. Web parser'lari esa API sxemasi rad etadigan qiymatlarni o'tkazib yuboradi.
rawFindings.impact: /articles?page=10001 da web parsePage chegarasiz, API esa `max(10_000)` (.catch yo'q). /vacancies?region=<30 ta uzun slug> yoki ?company=… da web 30×100 belgigacha qabul qiladi, API esa area max 500 va company max 2000 (.catch yo'q). Natijada doimiy noto'g'ri URL 503 + Retry-After: 120 oladi, monitoring soxta uzilish ko'radi, crawler qayta uraveradi. Round 3 gacha bu 200 bo'lardi.
rawFindings.evidence: lib/list.ts:17-19 `return Number.isFinite(page) && page > 1 ? page : 1;` (yuqori chegara yo'q); api articles.routes.ts:34 `page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10_000)`; articles/index/+data.ts:20-23 catch→null→`throw render(503)`; lib/vacancies/query.ts:87 `.slice(0, 30)`, :120,:124; api vacancies.routes.ts:36 `area: z.string().max(500).optional()`, :41 `company: z.string().max(2000)`; server.ts:261-265 ZodError→400; vacancies/+data.ts:26,29.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Web parser'larida API bilan bir xil chegara qo'ying (page ≤ API max, ro'yxat umumiy uzunligi ≤ 500/2000). +data'da ApiError 4xx ni 404 yoki bo'sh natija deb bilsin, 503 faqat status 0, 5xx yoki timeout uchun qolsin. Muqobil: API list sxemalariga ham `.catch` qo'shing.

rawFindings.title: Variant URL'larning canonical'i boshqa kontentga qaraydi, bo'sh chuqur sahifalar indekslanadi
rawFindings.rootCause: Canonical whitelist `page` ni saqlaydi, lekin kontentni o'zgartiradigan boshqa parametrlarni tashlaydi: workType, experience, salary, company, size, sort va bir nechta region. Slug faqat regex bilan tekshiriladi, mavjudligi tekshirilmaydi. API sahifa raqamini pageCount bilan cheklamaydi.
rawFindings.impact: /vacancies?workType=remote&page=3 ning canonical'i /vacancies?page=3, ya'ni filtrsiz ro'yxatning boshqa e'lonlari. /articles?sort=popular&page=2 → /articles?page=2. /vacancies?page=999 yoki ?region=mavjud-emas bo'sh ro'yxat, 200 va o'ziga qaragan canonical bilan chiqadi (soft-404 va cheksiz crawl tuzog'i). ?q=…&category=it da bir vaqtda noindex va boshqa URL'ga canonical bor — Google tavsiya qilmaydigan zid signal. Canonical parametrlarni alifbo tartibida yozadi (category&region), UI havolalari esa region&category, ya'ni canonical ichki havolada hech uchramaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: vacancies/+Head.tsx:19-23 `category`, `region` (faqat bitta), `page: query.page > 1 ? … : undefined`; :52 `noindex={Boolean(q)}` canonical bilan birga; articles/index/+Head.tsx:18-21 sort tashlanadi; companies/+Head.tsx:13-16; lib/vacancies/query.ts:130 page ≤ 10 000, :146-152 UI tartibi region→category; lib/i18n/head.ts:30 `Object.keys(params).sort()`; api vacancies.service.ts:449 `skip = (page - 1) * pageSize` (clamp yo'q).
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Canonical'da page faqat tashlangan filtr bo'lmaganda qolsin, aks holda sahifa noindex bo'lsin (yoki filtrlangan to'plamning 1-sahifasiga qarasin). Natija 0 ta yoki page > pageCount bo'lsa noindex qo'ying. noindex sahifada canonical chiqarmang. Parametr tartibini toSearchParams bilan bir xil qiling.

rawFindings.title: employer/+Head.tsx va admin/+Head.tsx shaxsiy pastki sahifalarga meros o'tadi: takror description va noindex sahifada canonical
rawFindings.rootCause: vike-react `Head` yig'iluvchi (cumulative). seo-1 faqat vacancies va companies ro'yxat Head'larini guard qildi. Wave1 needsOutside'dagi employer va admin qoldig'i bajarilmagan.
rawFindings.impact: /employer/applications, /employer/candidates, /employer/vacancies, /new va /@id/edit sahifalarida employer landing description'i, og:title'i va shu yo'lning o'ziga qaragan canonical'i chiqadi, pastki Head esa noindex va boshqa description beradi. Natijada ikkitadan description, og:title va og:type hamda noindex + canonical ziddiyati. admin/users'da bir xil Seo ikki marta (ikki canonical, ikki robots).
rawFindings.evidence: employer/+Head.tsx:6-8 `<Seo title={t.meta.employer.title} … canonical={canonical} />` (noindex yo'q, canonical joriy yo'ldan); employer/applications/+Head.tsx:8-12 `noindex`; node_modules/vike-react/dist/config.js:26-28 `Head: { env: { server: true }, cumulative: true }`; admin/+Head.tsx va admin/users/+Head.tsx ikkalasi `canonical={canonical} noindex`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: employer/+Head.tsx da ro'yxat sahifalaridagi kabi guard qo'ying (`pageLocale(pageContext).pathname !== "/employer"` bo'lsa null) yoki landing'ni employer/index/ ga ko'chiring. admin/+Head.tsx ni ham faqat /admin da chizing.

rawFindings.title: Har sahifada og:title va viewport ikki marta, detail sahifada ikki xil og:title va og:image
rawFindings.rootCause: vike-react `+title` qiymatidan `<title>` bilan birga og:title ham chiqaradi va sukut bo'yicha viewport meta'sini ham qo'yadi. Seo, detail Head'lar va HeadDefault ularni yana chiqaradi. seo-1 hisobotidagi "exactly one og:title" kutilmasi bajarilmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Barcha sahifalarda ikkita og:title va ikkita viewport bor. Vakansiya detail'da og:title "X — Kompaniya | ISH BOR!" va "X — Kompaniya", og:image esa ham /api/og/vacancy/…, ham /logo.png. Ulashish preview'i crawler'ga bog'liq bo'lib qoladi va wave1 test kutilmasi yiqiladi.
rawFindings.evidence: node_modules/vike-react/dist/integration/onRenderHtml.js:73 `<title>${title}</title><meta property="og:title" content="${title}" />`, :80 va :134 viewport; HeadDefault.tsx:43 `<meta name="viewport" …>`, :56 `og:image` logo; Seo.tsx:26 `<meta property="og:title" …>`; vacancies/@slug/+Head.tsx:125 og:title, :129 og:image; vacancies/@slug/+title.ts:11.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: og:title'ni Seo va detail Head'lardan olib tashlang (vike-react uni +title'dan chiqaradi) yoki `+title` o'rniga faqat bitta manba qoldiring. Viewport'ni HeadDefault'dan olib tashlang. HeadDefault'dagi logo og:image'ni faqat sahifa o'z rasmini bermaganda chiqaring.

rawFindings.title: Vakansiya og:image URL'ida til yo'q: i18n-10 web qismi bajarilmagan
rawFindings.rootCause: API /api/og/vacancy/:slug?lang=uz|ru|en ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, lekin web Head URL'ga `lang` qo'shmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: /ru va /en vakansiya havolalari Telegram va boshqa messenjerlarda "so'm dan" va "Maosh ko'rsatilmagan" kabi o'zbekcha rasm bilan ulashiladi. API'dagi lokalizatsiya ishi foydalanilmaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: vacancies/@slug/+Head.tsx:129 `content={`${API_URL}/api/og/vacancy/${vacancy.slug}`}`; api og.routes.ts:8-22 OG_TEXT uz/ru/en, :47 `const lang = ogLang(req.query.lang)`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: og:image'ni `${API_URL}/api/og/vacancy/${slug}${locale === "uz" ? "" : `?lang=${locale}`}` qiling (kesh kaliti API'da allaqachon tilni hisobga oladi).

rawFindings.title: Nomzodlar bazasi kvota holati ru/en interfeysda xom o'zbekcha server matnini ko'rsatadi
rawFindings.rootCause: D-071 bilan qo'shilgan yangi 429 holati `err.message` ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri saqlab chizadi. Rate-limit xabari API'da faqat o'zbekcha.
rawFindings.impact: RU/EN ish beruvchi soatlik kvotaga yetganda "Juda ko'p so'rov. N soniyadan so'ng qayta urinib ko'ring." matnini ko'radi. Round 3 da qo'shilgan yangi o'zbekcha matn oqimi.
rawFindings.evidence:
+Page.tsx:35 `if (err.status === 429) return { kind: "quota", message: err.message && err.message !== "Xatolik" ? err.message : "" };`, :197 `{state.message &&

{state.message}

}`; api server.ts:171-176 `message: `Juda ko'p so'rov. ${…} soniyadan so'ng qayta urinib ko'ring.``; candidates.routes.ts:73-80 route rateLimit 300/soat.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Server matni o'rniga lug'at matnini ishlating (masalan `t.errors.codes.RATE_LIMITED`, yoki uch tilda alohida `candidatesPage.quota` kaliti). err.message faqat uz'da, apiErrorText orqali ko'rsatilsin.

rawFindings.title: Yangi `t.errors` lug'ati hech qayerda ishlatilmaydi, TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE matni esa Rule K matniga zid
rawFindings.rootCause: Wave2 reviewer ApiErrorCode va errors {generic, network, codes} ni uch tilda qo'shdi, lekin hech bir chaqiruv `byCode` yoki `network` ni uzatmaydi. errorText() ham byCode qabul qilmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: i18n-3 amalda yopilmagan: ru/en da ma'lum kodlar uchun ham umumiy "xatolik" chiqadi, uz da esa xom server matni, jumladan inglizcha zod xabarlari ko'rinadi. 17×3 ta kalit o'lik. Kelajakda ulansa, codes.TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE ("Telegram hozir ishlamayapti…") kontraktdagi Rule K matnidan ("Telegram orqali tasdiqlash hozircha mavjud emas…") farq qiladi.
rawFindings.evidence: apiExtra.ts:117-121 `texts: { fallback; network?; byCode? }` — repo bo'yicha `byCode` faqat shu yerda; `t.errors`/`errors.codes` ga lug'at fayllaridan tashqarida murojaat yo'q (grep bo'sh); lib/admin/useNotice.ts errorText → `apiErrorText(error, locale, { fallback, network })`; messages.uz.ts:1698 `TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE: "Telegram hozir ishlamayapti. …"` vs :200 `unavailable: "Telegram orqali tasdiqlash hozircha mavjud emas. …"`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: apiErrorText va errorText chaqiruvlariga `byCode: t.errors.codes, network: t.errors.network` ni uzating, yoki kalitlarni olib tashlang. codes.TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE matnini uch tilda t.telegram.unavailable bilan bir xil qiling.

rawFindings.title: Yangi tiklash UI'sida tilga bog'lanmagan qiymatlar: brauzer tilidagi sana va o'zbekcha placeholder
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 da yozilgan komponentlar i18n-7 siyosatini (formatDate(iso, locale)) chetlab, locale'siz toLocaleString() ishlatadi. Email placeholder'i barcha tillarda o'zbekcha.
rawFindings.impact: Admin tiklash so'rovlari va xavfsizlik hodisalari sanasi sahifa tilida emas, brauzer tilida va Asia/Tashkent'siz chiqadi. /ru/login?recover=manual va /en/... da email maydonida "ism@email.com" (o'zbekcha "ism") ko'rinadi.
rawFindings.evidence: RecoveryRequests.tsx:158 `new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleString()`, :169 `toLocaleDateString()`, :184, :293; auth/RecoveryPanel.tsx:264 `placeholder="ism@email.com"`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: lib/format.js dagi formatDate(iso, locale) ishlatilsin. Placeholder lug'atdan olinsin (masalan `t.recovery.emailPlaceholder`, uch tilda).

rawFindings.title: /login?reset=<token> da til almashtirish: header tiklash oqimini yo'qotadi, footer tokenni URL'ga qaytaradi
rawFindings.rootCause: ResetMode tokenni replaceState bilan manzil qatoridan olib tashlaydi. LanguageSwitcher `window.location.search` ni o'qiydi (endi bo'sh), Footer LocaleLinks esa SSR paytidagi `pageContext.urlParsed.searchOriginal` ni o'qiydi (tokenli). Ikki til almashtirgich bir-biriga zid ishlaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Headerdagi til tanlagich /ru/login ga o'tadi: yangi parol formasi yo'qoladi va foydalanuvchi Telegram havolasini qayta bosishi kerak. Footerdagi RU/EN havolalari tokenni DOM'da saqlaydi va bosilganda uni yana URL va tarixga qaytaradi — D-045 dagi "token manzil qatorida qolmaydi" niyatiga zid.
rawFindings.evidence: auth/RecoveryPanel.tsx:524 `window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "", window.location.pathname);`; LanguageSwitcher.tsx:46 `const suffix = … window.location.search + window.location.hash`; Footer.tsx:16 `const search = pageContext.urlParsed?.searchOriginal ?? "";`, :169 `href={localizeHref(pathname, loc) + search}`; /login COMPACT_PREFIXES da yo'q, ya'ni to'liq footer chiqadi.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Footer LocaleLinks maxfiy parametrlarni (`reset`) tashlasin va joriy manzildan foydalansin. ResetMode'da til almashganda token xotirada saqlansin yoki tokenni yo'qotmaydigan xabar ko'rsatilsin. Ikkala switcher bir xil manbadan (pageLocale va tozalangan search) foydalansin.

rawFindings.title: API WEB_ORIGIN production'da jimgina localhost bo'lib qoladi: sitemap/robots hosti canonical'dan farq qiladi (seo-10 API qismi)
rawFindings.rootCause: Web build VITE_SITE_URL yo'q bo'lsa to'xtaydi, lekin API env sxemasida WEB_ORIGIN'ning sukut qiymati http://localhost:5173 va production superRefine uni tekshirmaydi. Canonical va sitemap ikki xil env'dan olinadi.
rawFindings.impact: WEB_ORIGIN qo'yilmagan yoki boshqa domen bo'lsa robots.txt'dagi `Sitemap:`, sitemap index'dagi `<loc>` va barcha sitemap URL'lari localhost'ga yoki canonical'dan boshqa hostga qaraydi. Google sitemap'ni rad etadi yoki URL'larni canonical bilan moslay olmaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: env.ts:47 `WEB_ORIGIN: z.string().default("http://localhost:5173")`; superRefine (env.ts:140-181) production'da WEB_ORIGIN'ni tekshirmaydi; seo.routes.ts:15 `const PUBLIC_ORIGIN = env.WEB_ORIGIN;`, :72 `Sitemap: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN}/sitemap.xml`, :220-223.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: superRefine'da NODE_ENV=production uchun WEB_ORIGIN https bo'lishini va localhost bo'lmasligini talab qiling. DEPLOY.md smoke-testiga "sitemap host = VITE_SITE_URL" tekshiruvini qo'shing.

rawFindings.title: Web zaxira robots.txt API robots'idan ajralib qoldi (saved= crawl tuzog'i qoidasi yo'q)
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 da API robots'iga `Disallow: /*?*saved=` (seo-13), `Allow: /api/og/` va `Allow: /uploads/` qo'shildi, lekin "bir xil bo'lishi kerak" deb yozilgan web zaxira ro'yxati yangilanmadi.
rawFindings.impact: API ishlamay qolganda yoki API_URL bo'lmaganda berilgan robots.txt'da ?saved= tuzog'i ochiq qoladi va crawler xulqi API holatiga qarab o'zgaradi.
rawFindings.evidence: api/seo.js:25 "seo.routes.ts dagi PRIVATE_PATHS bilan bir xil", :43-51 fallbackRobots faqat `Disallow: /api` + PRIVATE_PATHS; api seo.routes.ts:52 `CRAWL_TRAP_PATTERNS = ["/*?*saved="]`, :65, :71.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: fallbackRobots'ga `Disallow: /*?*saved=` ni qo'shing. Ro'yxatni bitta umumiy JSON yoki modulda saqlang, yoki mosligini e2e/unit test bilan tekshiring.

rawFindings.title: API matnlaridagi maosh qo'shimchalari hamon "so'm dan"/"so'm gacha", web esa "so'mdan" (i18n-12 API qismi)
rawFindings.rootCause: i18n-12 faqat web lug'atida tuzatilgan. API formatter va OG uz matni eski ajratilgan shaklda qolgan.
rawFindings.impact: Bir xil vakansiya saytda "5 000 000 so'mdan", Telegram xabari va OG rasmida esa "5 000 000 so'm dan" ko'rinishida chiqadi — imlo nomuvofiq.
rawFindings.evidence: format.ts:6 `return `${fmt(min)} ${cur} dan`;`, :7 `${cur} gacha`; web messages.uz.ts:910-911 `(v) => `${v} so'mdan``; og.routes.ts:16 uz `from: "dan", to: "gacha"` (salaryLabel uz uchun formatSalaryLabel'ni chaqiradi).
rawFindings.recommendedFix: format.ts'da `${cur}dan` / `${cur}gacha` qiling (UZS uchun "so'mdan"). OG rasmlar keshi updatedAt'ga bog'liq — deploydan keyin eski rasmlar kesh TTL'igacha qolishini hisobga oling.

rawFindings.title: Hujjatlar yangi SEO xulqiga zid: D-027 bekor qilinmagan, DESIGN.md va README eski holatni yozadi
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 SSR xatolarini 503 ga, canonical'ni parametrli qilib va robots'da /uploads/ ni ochib o'zgartirdi, lekin eski qaror va dizayn hujjatidagi faktlar yangilanmadi yoki "superseded" deb belgilanmadi (D-001: eskirgan faktlar tuzatiladi).
rawFindings.impact: Keyingi dasturchi D-027 va DESIGN.md ga tayanib 200 + noindex xulqini "to'g'ri" deb qaytarishi, yoki README bo'yicha /uploads/ ni robots'da yopib, og:image'ni (seo-6) buzishi mumkin. ISSUES.md ning o'zi ham ichki ziddiyatli.
rawFindings.evidence: DECISIONS.md:293-301 D-027 "API xatosida detail sahifalar avvalgidek 200 + noindex … 503 qilinmadi" (D-040..D-082 da uni bekor qiladigan qaror yo'q) vs vacancies/@slug/+data.ts:32 `throw render(503)`; apps/web/DESIGN.md:483 "Ro'yxat kanonigi filtrsiz `/articles`" vs articles/index/+Head.tsx:18-21; DESIGN.md:936 va :1004-1005 detail API xatosi "sahifa yiqilmaydi … (indekslanmaydi)"; README.md:132 "`/uploads/` yopiq" vs api seo.routes.ts:65 `"Allow: /uploads/"`; ISSUES.md:104-105 ISSUE-070/071 "NOT FIXED" vs :3263-3264 "FIXED".
rawFindings.recommendedFix: DECISIONS.md'ga D-027 ni bekor qiluvchi Round 3 qarorini qo'shing (SSR'da 404/503, klient navigatsiyada retry). DESIGN.md SEO va holatlar bandlarini, README robots bandini va ISSUES.md xulosa jadvalini joriy kodga moslang.

rawFindings.title: Custom Select va LanguageSwitcher: klaviatura bilan faol variant deyarli ko'rinmaydi (1.1:1)
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 da Select aria-activedescendant modeliga o'tkazildi: haqiqiy fokus tugmada qoladi, faol variant faqat fon rangi bilan belgilanadi. Bu fon (bg-surface-2 yoki bg-signal/15) ro'yxat fonidan (bg-surface / bg-signal-soft) deyarli farq qilmaydi; outline yoki ring yo'q.
rawFindings.impact: Ko'ruvchi klaviatura foydalanuvchisi ↑/↓ bosganda qaysi variant tanlanishini ko'rmaydi (WCAG 2.4.7, 1.4.11). Bu hudud, saralash, kompaniya formasi va til tanlagichidagi barcha custom select'larga ta'sir qiladi; D-060 dagi "custom Select'da fokus ko'rinadi" talabi bajarilmagan.
rawFindings.evidence: Select.tsx:174 ro'yxat `bg-surface`; Select.tsx:188-190 `${active ? "bg-signal-soft font-medium text-signal" : "text-ink"} ${focused ? (active ? "bg-signal/15" : "bg-surface-2") : ""}`. O'lchangan: kunduzgi #EEF3FB vs #FFFFFF = 1.11:1, tungi #1A2236 vs #121828 ≈ 1.13:1; tanlangan variantda bg-signal-soft -> bg-signal/15 farqi ≈ 1.05:1. LanguageSwitcher.tsx:156-158 xuddi shunday (`focused ? "bg-surface-2" : ""`).
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Faol variantga kamida 3:1 kontrastli indikator bering: masalan `ring-2 ring-inset ring-[rgb(var(--focus))]` yoki chap tomonda 3px `--focus` chiziq, yoki faol fonni bg-signal + oq matn qiling. Select va LanguageSwitcher'da bir xil qiling.

rawFindings.title: Chat: "Eskiroq xabarlar" yuklanganda role=log jonli hududi 50 tagacha eski xabarni o'qib beradi
rawFindings.rootCause: D-078 cursor sahifalash eski xabarlarni mavjud `role="log" aria-live="polite"` konteyneri ichiga, ro'yxat boshiga qo'shadi. Jonli hudud 800 ms dan keyin yoqiladi va aria-relevant sukut bo'yicha additions — prepend ham qo'shilish hisoblanadi.
rawFindings.impact: Ekran o'quvchi foydalanuvchisi "Eskiroq xabarlar" tugmasini bosganda MESSAGES_PAGE=50 tagacha eski xabar ketma-ket e'lon qilinadi; yangi kelgan xabarni ajratib bo'lmaydi, suhbat tarixini ko'rish amalda foydalanib bo'lmas holga keladi.
rawFindings.evidence:
MessageList.tsx:155-164: `` va `
    {rows}
`; MessageList.tsx:97-100 live 800 ms dan keyin true; lib/messages/api.ts:18 `MESSAGES_PAGE = 50`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Eski xabarlarni yuklash paytida jonli hududni vaqtincha o'chiring (older === "loading" bo'lganda va prepend'dan keyingi kadrgacha aria-live="off"), yoki eski sahifani log'dan tashqaridagi alohida ro'yxatga chizing; yuklash natijasini bitta qisqa sr-only status bilan e'lon qiling ("N ta eski xabar yuklandi").

rawFindings.title: ConfirmDialog, RatingDialog va jamoa profili dialogida hali ham max-height va ichki scroll yo'q
rawFindings.rootCause: a11y-ui-1 faqat ApplicationStatusDialog'da tuzatilgan; qolgan uchta markaziy dialog panelida balandlik chegarasi yo'q, overlay esa `fixed inset-0 flex` va useDialog body scroll'ini qulflaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Past ekranda (740x360 landshaft, yoki klaviatura ochiq telefon) RatingDialog (~390px) va boshqa panellarning pastki qismi — tasdiqlash/yuborish tugmalari — ekrandan chiqib qoladi va ularga scroll qilib bo'lmaydi. Baholash yoki o'chirishni tasdiqlash imkonsiz bo'ladi.
rawFindings.evidence: ConfirmDialog.tsx:55 `className="w-full max-w-md animate-pop rounded-2xl border ... p-5 shadow-pop focus:outline-none sm:p-6"` (max-h/overflow yo'q); RatingDialog.tsx:71 `relative w-full max-w-md animate-sheet-in rounded-t-3xl ... sm:animate-pop sm:rounded-3xl sm:p-6` (ichida StarInput text-3xl + 3 qatorli textarea + xato + tugmalar); admin/team/TeamList.tsx:175 `w-full max-w-md animate-sheet-in rounded-t-3xl ... sm:rounded-3xl`. Taqqoslash: ApplicationStatusDialog.tsx:88 `max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] ... overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Uchala panelga `max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain` qo'shing (yoki umumiy DialogPanel komponentini ajratib, tana scroll + sticky footer qiling) va 740x360 hamda 360x640 da tekshiring.

rawFindings.title: Filtr drawer ichidagi Select'da Escape butun drawer'ni yopadi va qoralama filtrlar yo'qoladi
rawFindings.rootCause: useDialog document darajasidagi keydown handler'i Escape'da `e.defaultPrevented` ni tekshirmaydi. Select Escape'ni o'zi qayta ishlab preventDefault qiladi, lekin React root handler'idan keyin document handler baribir ishlaydi va dialogni yopadi. Round 3 da CompanyFilterDrawer useDialog'ga ko'chirildi, ammo ichki vidjetlar uchun himoya qo'shilmadi (Header'da qo'shilgan).
rawFindings.impact: Kompaniyalar filtr drawer'ida (telefon/planshet) hudud ro'yxatini Escape bilan yopmoqchi bo'lgan klaviatura foydalanuvchisi butun drawer'ni yopadi; "Natijalarni ko'rsatish" bosilmagan qoralama o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi, D-060 dagi "Escape yopadi va fokus tugmada qoladi" va'dasi dialog ichida buziladi.
rawFindings.evidence: useDialog.ts:31-35 `if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); closeRef.current(); return; }` — defaultPrevented tekshiruvi yo'q; Select.tsx:85-89 Escape'da `e.preventDefault(); close(true)`; CompanyFilterDrawer.tsx:47 `useDialog(open, panelRef, onClose)`, :90 ichida `<CompanyFilters>`; CompanyFilters.tsx:70 `<Select id={`${uid}-region`} ...>`; Header.tsx:70 va :84 esa `e.defaultPrevented` bilan himoyalangan.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: useDialog handler'ining boshida `if (e.defaultPrevented) return;` qo'shing (yoki Select Escape'da `e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation()`/stopPropagation qilsin), shunda ichki listbox yopilib, dialog ochiq qoladi.

rawFindings.title: Mobil menyudagi til tanlagich ro'yxati chap tomondan qirqiladi (overflow-y-auto qo'shilgach)
rawFindings.rootCause: a11y-ui-4 uchun mobil menyu paneliga `overflow-y-auto` qo'shildi; CSS bo'yicha overflow-x ham auto bo'ladi va panel ichidagi absolute ro'yxatlar panel chegarasida qirqiladi. LanguageSwitcher ro'yxati `right-0 w-40` bilan tugmaning o'ng chetiga bog'langan, tugma esa qatorda chapda turadi.
rawFindings.impact: <1024px da mobil menyuda tilni ochganda ro'yxat panel chap chetidan ~35px chiqib ketadi va qirqiladi: "O'zbekcha", "Русский", "English" yorliqlarining bosh harflari ko'rinmaydi (avval faqat viewport ~10-20px qirqardi). Manfiy yo'nalishdagi toshishga scroll qilib bo'lmaydi.
rawFindings.evidence:
Header.tsx:369 `className="max-h-[calc(100dvh-6.5rem)] animate-slide-down overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain border-t ... px-4 py-4 lg:hidden"`; Header.tsx:387-389 `
` (ThemeToggle h-9 w-9 → switcher x≈64..125px); LanguageSwitcher.tsx:141 `absolute right-0 z-50 mt-2 w-40` → chap chet ≈ -35px, li `px-3` → matn ≈ -23px dan boshlanadi.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Mobil menyudagi LanguageSwitcher uchun ro'yxatni `left-0` ga bog'lang (className prop orqali, masalan `listClassName="left-0"`), yoki mobil menyuda tillarni ro'yxat o'rniga oddiy radio/segment tugmalar sifatida chizing.

rawFindings.title: Tiklash va telefon xavfsizligi oqimlarida fokus <body>ga tushadi, natija yangi qo'shilgan role=status ichida
rawFindings.rootCause: Muvaffaqiyatli amal fokusdagi elementni o'z ichiga olgan formani/panelni unmount qiladi va fokus hech qayerga ko'chirilmaydi; natija kartasi esa DOM'ga matni bilan birga qo'shilgan role=status (bunday jonli hududni ko'p ekran o'quvchilar e'lon qilmaydi). Escape/Cancel ham fokusni ochgan tugmaga qaytarmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: /login?recover=1 da "Yuborish" dan keyin, ?recover=status da "Telegram orqali davom etish" dan keyin va profildagi PasswordPrompt tasdiqlangach/bekor qilingach klaviatura foydalanuvchisi sahifa boshiga tashlanadi; ekran o'quvchi Telegram havolasi paydo bo'lganini bilmasligi mumkin. D-060 "Escape va fokus qaytishi" hamda gap5-3 naqshi yangi UI'da takrorlangan.
rawFindings.evidence: RecoveryPanel.tsx:168-190 `{link ? <LinkCard .../> : <form ...>}` (submit tugmasi unmount); :100 LinkCard `role="status"` yangi qo'shiladi; :459-485 `status && !link` bloki "continueTelegram" tugmasi bilan birga yo'qoladi; PhoneSecurity.tsx:86 `setAction(null)` → :157 PasswordPrompt unmount (fokus ichidagi tugmada edi); :167-170 onCancel faqat setAction(null); PasswordPrompt.tsx:44-46 Escape → onCancel; PhoneSecurity.tsx:175-179 notice ham yangi role=status.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: LinkCard va natija bloklarida sarlavha/konteynerga tabIndex=-1 berib, mount bo'lganda fokusni unga o'tkazing (ManualDone naqshi); PasswordPrompt yopilganda fokusni ochgan tugmaga qaytaring; doimiy (bo'sh) aria-live konteyner ichida matnni almashtiring.

rawFindings.title: To'liq bog'langan hisobda Telegram holatini yangilash xatosi ko'rsatilmaydi — eski raqam jim qoladi
rawFindings.rootCause: actionError faqat `!allDone` bloki ichida chiziladi. Round 3 da PhoneSecurity'ning "Yangilash" tugmasi va unlink/removeBackup'dan keyingi onChanged → refresh() allDone holatida ham chaqiriladi; refresh yiqilsa statusError=true bo'ladi, lekin status eski qoladi va xato hech qayerda ko'rinmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Botda raqamni almashtirgach "Yangilash" bosilganda tarmoq/server xatosi bo'lsa foydalanuvchi eski raqam va eski holatni xatosiz ko'radi (masalan "Telegram uzildi" notice'i yonida hali ham "bog'langan"). Bu "xato bo'sh/eskirgan holat bo'lib ko'rinmasin" qoidasini buzadi.
rawFindings.evidence:
TelegramConnect.tsx:115 `const actionError = error ?? (statusError && status ? t.profileHub.states.loadError : null);`; :216 `{!allDone && (` ... :240-244 `{actionError && (

{actionError}

)}`; :258 `onChanged={() => void refresh()}`; :59-61 catch → faqat setStatusError(true).
rawFindings.recommendedFix: actionError (yoki alohida refresh xatosi) blokini `!allDone` tashqarisiga, PhoneSecurity ustiga chiqaring va retry tugmasi bilan role=alert ko'rsating.

rawFindings.title: Admin tiklash so'rovlari kartasida noto'g'ri <dl> tuzilmasi (axe definition-list/dlitem)
rawFindings.rootCause: <dl> ichida ikki qavat <div> bor: tashqi `div.flex-col` ichida Field komponentlari (har biri div > dt+dd). HTML/ARIA faqat bitta o'rovchi div'ga ruxsat beradi — Round 3 da CompanyOverview'da tuzatilgan xatoning o'zi yangi UI'da qaytgan.
rawFindings.impact: /admin/users?view=recovery da axe definition-list va dlitem xatolari; ekran o'quvchi "Aloqa" va "Yaratilgan" juftliklarini ta'rif ro'yxati sifatida o'qimaydi. Axe skaneri bu ko'rinishni tekshirmagan (faqat /admin/users).
rawFindings.evidence:
RecoveryRequests.tsx:152-160 `
...
......
`; :319-325 Field = `
..
..
`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Ichki `div.flex-col` o'rovchini olib tashlang (uchta Field'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri dl ichiga qo'ying, joylashuvni grid row/col-span bilan bering) yoki ikkinchi ustunni alohida <dl> qiling.

rawFindings.title: Tiklash so'rovi kartasida uzun kontakt/ism/izoh 360px da gorizontal toshadi
rawFindings.rootCause: Foydalanuvchi kiritgan erkin matnlar (contact, fullName, reviewNote) uchun break-words/[overflow-wrap:anywhere] berilmagan; grid ustuni min-content bo'yicha kengayadi. Faqat email (break-all) va details (break-words) himoyalangan.
rawFindings.impact: 360px ekranda karta ichki kengligi ~288px; bo'sh joysiz uzun kontakt (masalan 40+ belgili email yoki @telegram_username) yoki URL'li izoh kartani va sahifani gorizontal scroll'ga majbur qiladi.
rawFindings.evidence:
RecoveryRequests.tsx:146 `

{item.fullName}

`; :157 `{item.contact || r.none}` (Field dd :323 `mt-1 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink`, wrap yo'q); :183-186 reviewNote `

`; taqqoslang :147 `break-all` va :154 `break-words`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Field dd, h3 va reviewNote paragrafiga `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` (yoki break-words + min-w-0) qo'shing; grid elementlariga min-w-0 bering.

rawFindings.title: Tajriba formasidagi oy tanlagich color-scheme saytdagi mavzuga emas, OS sozlamasiga ergashadi
rawFindings.rootCause: a11y-ui-11 tuzatishi `colorScheme: "light dark"` ishlatdi — bu brauzerga foydalanuvchining OS afzalligini tanlatadi. Sayt mavzusi esa `.dark` klassi (qo'lda almashtiriladi, localStorage) bilan boshqariladi; loyihaning boshqa joylarida to'g'ri naqsh `dark:[color-scheme:dark]`.
rawFindings.impact: Saytda tungi mavzu + OS kunduzgi bo'lsa picker avvalgidek yorug' qoladi (xato tuzatilmagan); saytda kunduzgi mavzu + OS tungi bo'lsa oq maydondagi kalendar ikonkasi va native picker quyuq bo'lib, ikonka deyarli ko'rinmaydi (yangi regressiya).
rawFindings.evidence: ExperienceList.tsx:19-20 `const MONTH_STYLE: React.CSSProperties = { colorScheme: "light dark" };`, :347 va :362 `style={MONTH_STYLE}`; lib/theme.tsx:63 mavzu `document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')` bilan; AdminStates.tsx:10, FieldSelect.tsx:51 `dark:[color-scheme:dark]`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: MONTH_STYLE'ni olib tashlab input className'ga `[color-scheme:light] dark:[color-scheme:dark]` bering, yoki global.css'da `:root{color-scheme:light} .dark{color-scheme:dark}` qo'shing (a11y-ui-11 tavsiyasi).

rawFindings.title: Maqola kartalarida klaviatura fokusi faqat ring-signal/50 (kunduzgi 2.3:1, tungi 1.7:1)
rawFindings.rootCause: Havola `focus-visible:outline-none` bilan global konturni o'chiradi; o'rniga kartada yarim shaffof `focus-within:ring-signal/50`. Round 3 override faqat `focus:outline-none` ni tiklaydi, `focus-visible:outline-none` ni emas; tungi --signal quyuqlashtirilgani halqani yanada xiralashtirdi (1.92 → 1.71:1).
rawFindings.impact: /articles va bosh sahifadagi maqola kartalarida Tab bilan yurgan foydalanuvchi fokus qayerdaligini deyarli ko'rmaydi (WCAG 2.4.7/1.4.11); D-060 "interaktiv elementlarda fokus ko'rinadi" talabi va DESIGN.md dagi "Fokus har doim ko'rinadi" da'vosi bu yerda bajarilmaydi (a11y-ui-10 qoldig'i).
rawFindings.evidence: ArticleCard.tsx:22 `focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-signal/50`; :41 `<a ... className="after:absolute after:inset-0 after:content-[''] focus-visible:outline-none">`; ArticleFeatured.tsx:31, :52, :64 xuddi shunday; global.css:586 override faqat `.focus\:outline-none:focus-visible`. O'lchangan: signal/50 surface ustida kunduzgi 2.31:1, tungi 1.71:1.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Kartada shaffof bo'lmagan `focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-[rgb(var(--focus))]` (yoki ring-signal + ring-offset) ishlating, yoki havoladan focus-visible:outline-none ni olib tashlab, after psevdo-elementiga ring bering (VacancyCard naqshi).

rawFindings.title: aria-haspopup="true" (menu) menyu bo'lmagan panellarga qo'yilgan
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 da avatar, gamburger va qo'ng'iroq tugmalariga `aria-haspopup="true"` qo'shildi; "true" ARIA'da "menu" degani, lekin ochiladigan element role=menu/menuitem emas — <nav> havolalari va oddiy panel.
rawFindings.impact: Ekran o'quvchi "menyu tugmasi" deb e'lon qiladi va menyu klaviatura modelini kutadi; ichida esa oddiy havolalar va tugmalar (Tab bilan yuriladi). Reviewer topgan, tuzatilmagan.
rawFindings.evidence: Header.tsx:237 `aria-haspopup="true"` (account-menu = div > nav > ul > a); Header.tsx:345 `aria-haspopup="true"` (mobile-menu = div > nav); NotificationBell.tsx:53 `aria-haspopup="true"` (panel ichida havolalar ro'yxati).
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Disclosure naqshi uchun aria-haspopup ni olib tashlang (aria-expanded + aria-controls yetarli), yoki haqiqiy role=menu/menuitem modeliga o'ting.

rawFindings.title: Nomzod profilida hali ham ikkita h1 (a11y-ui-9 qoldig'i)
rawFindings.rootCause: ProfileHeader har bir profil tabida h1 (ism) chizadi, bo'lim komponentlari ham SectionHeader as="h1" yoki h1 ishlatadi; a11y-ui-9 da tavsiya qilingan h2 ga o'tkazish bajarilmagan.
rawFindings.impact: Har bir /profile tabida ikkita h1: sarlavhalar bo'yicha navigatsiya qiluvchi ekran o'quvchi foydalanuvchisi sahifa tuzilishini noto'g'ri tushunadi; ResumeWizard'da fokus ikkinchi h1 ga ko'chiriladi.
rawFindings.evidence: pages/profile/+Page.tsx:188 `<ProfileHeader .../>` barcha tablarda; ProfileHeader.tsx:65 `<h1 id="profile-hub-name" ...>`; ProfileOverview.tsx:47 `<h1 className="sr-only">`; PersonalInfo.tsx:104, AccountSettings.tsx:43, ApplicationList.tsx:66, SavedJobs.tsx:56 `SectionHeader as="h1"`; ResumeWizard.tsx:86 `<h1 id="resume-wizard-title" ...>`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Bo'lim sarlavhalarini h2 qiling (SectionHeader as="h2", ProfileOverview sr-only sarlavhani h2) yoki ProfileHeader'dagi ismni h2/p qilib, tab sarlavhasini yagona h1 qoldiring.

rawFindings.title: Footer navigatsiyasining aria-label'i barcha tillarda inglizcha "Footer"
rawFindings.rootCause: Landmark nomi i18n lug'atidan emas, qattiq yozilgan; a11y-ui-9 va i18n-9 needsOutside'da qayd etilgan, lekin hech bir guruh tuzatmagan.
rawFindings.impact: uz/ru interfeysda ekran o'quvchi landmark ro'yxatida inglizcha "Footer navigation" eshitadi (WCAG 3.1.2 — qism tili belgilanmagan, nom tarjima qilinmagan).
rawFindings.evidence: Footer.tsx:140 `<nav aria-label="Footer">`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: types.ts va uch lug'atga `footer.navLabel` kalitini qo'shib, `aria-label={t.footer.navLabel}` ishlating.

rawFindings.title: /admin/users jadvali: amallar ustuni sarlavhasi bo'sh va "Email" sarlavhasi tarjima qilinmagan (gap5-6 o'tkazib yuborilgan)
rawFindings.rootCause: gap5-6 uchun AdminActionsHeader komponenti yaratilib boshqa admin sahifalarga qo'llangan, lekin Round 3 da o'zgartirilgan users sahifasi eski `<th> </th>` bilan qolgan.
rawFindings.impact: Ekran o'quvchi jadval kataklarini o'qiganda amallar ustunining nomi yo'q (bo'sh sarlavha), "Email" esa ru/en/uz da bir xil inglizcha; gap5-6 FIXED deb belgilangan, ammo foydalanuvchilar jadvalida bajarilmagan.
rawFindings.evidence: pages/admin/users/+Page.tsx:157 `<th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold">Email</th>`; :161 `<th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold"> </th>`; taqqoslang admin/companies/+Page.tsx:108, reviews:114, vacancies:142 `<AdminActionsHeader label={...} />`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: :161 ni `<AdminActionsHeader label={t.contentAdmin.articles.columns.actions} />` bilan almashtiring va "Email" ni i18n kaliti orqali chiqaring.

rawFindings.title: "Qidiruvni saqlash" popover'i D-060 klaviatura va e'lon qoidalariga moslashtirilmagan
rawFindings.rootCause: Popover faqat useClickOutside bilan yopiladi (Escape fokusni qaytarmaydi); xato va muvaffaqiyat matnlari jonli hududsiz; muvaffaqiyatdan keyin panel 1.6 s da o'zi yopiladi. Fayl Round 3 da umuman o'zgarmagan (needsOutside).
rawFindings.impact: Popover ichida Escape, "Bekor qilish" yoki avto-yopilishdan keyin fokus <body>ga tushadi; saqlash xatosi va "obuna yaratildi" ekran o'quvchiga e'lon qilinmaydi; xato matni xom server matni.
rawFindings.evidence:
SaveSearchButton.tsx:44 `useClickOutside(boxRef, () => setOpen(false), open);`; :62-65 `window.setTimeout(() => { setOpen(false); setDone(false); }, 1600);`; :116 `

{t.alerts.created}

` (role yo'q); :154-157 xato `

{error}

` (role=alert yo'q); :168-171 Cancel faqat setOpen(false).
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Header/NotificationBell naqshini qo'llang: Escape va Cancel'da fokusni tugmaga qaytaring, ochilganda nom maydoniga fokus bering, xatoga role=alert, muvaffaqiyatga doimiy aria-live hudud qo'shing, avto-yopilishda ham fokusni tugmaga qaytaring.

rawFindings.title: Rezyume PDF yuklangach yoki o'chirilgach fokus yo'qoladi (gap5-3 qoldig'i)
rawFindings.rootCause: Yuklashda dropzone tugmasi fayl kartasi bilan almashtiriladi, o'chirishda fayl kartasi (fokusdagi "O'chirish" tugmasi bilan) yo'qoladi; fokus yangi boshqaruv elementiga ko'chirilmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Klaviatura foydalanuvchisi rezyume faylini yuklagach/o'chirgach sahifa boshiga tashlanadi va natija e'lon qilinmaydi; gap5-3 PARTIAL sifatida qolgan.
rawFindings.evidence: ResumeFile.tsx:37-38 `onChange(await uploadResumeFile(token, file));`; :64-68 `await deleteResumeFile(token); onChange(null);`; :112 o'chirish tugmasi fayl kartasi ichida, :118-120 dropzone tugmasi — ikkalasi ham holatga qarab almashtiriladi; faylda focus() chaqiruvi yo'q.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Yuklashdan keyin fayl kartasidagi "Almashtirish"/"Ochish" tugmasiga, o'chirishdan keyin dropzone tugmasiga ref orqali fokus bering va natijani aria-live bilan e'lon qiling.

rawFindings.title: Profil telefon maydoni "majburiy" deb belgilanadi, lekin bo'sh qiymat qabul qilinadi
rawFindings.rootCause: gap5-2 tuzatishi Field'ga `required={!verified}` berdi (yulduzcha + sr-only "(majburiy)"), ammo validatsiya isPhoneComplete bo'sh raqamni to'g'ri deb qaytaradi va saqlash `phone: null` yuboradi.
rawFindings.impact: Ko'ruvchi va ekran o'quvchi foydalanuvchiga maydon majburiy deyiladi, lekin bo'sh qoldirilsa xato chiqmaydi va saqlanadi — noto'g'ri yo'riqnoma (WCAG 3.3.2), yorliq va xatti-harakat mos emas.
rawFindings.evidence: PersonalInfo.tsx:155 `required={!verified}`; :77 `if (!verified && !isPhoneComplete(form.phone)) {`; PhoneInput.tsx:52-55 `return national.length === 0 || national.length === 9;`; PersonalInfo.tsx:88 `phone: verified ? undefined : form.phone || null`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Yoki required belgisini olib tashlang (telefon ixtiyoriy, faqat format tekshiriladi), yoki bo'sh raqamni ham xato deb hisoblab, xato matnini "telefon kiritilishi shart" qiling; PhoneInput'ga aria-required prop qo'shing.

rawFindings.title: Qo'ng'iroq popover'ida o'qilmagan bildirishnoma faqat rang bilan belgilanadi

rawFindings.title: DESIGN.md parol almashtirish oqimi yo'q deydi, kod esa /login?recover=1 ga olib boradi

rawFindings.evidence: DESIGN.md:341-342 "Parolni almashtirish va hisobni o'chirish uchun API yo'q — soxta tugma emas, yordam markaziga yo'naltirish."; profile/AccountSettings.tsx:90-91 `<a href={l("/login?recover=1")} ...><IconShield size={15} /> {s.resetPassword}`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: DESIGN.md:341 ni yangilang: parol Telegram orqali /login?recover=1 da tiklanadi (D-045), faqat hisobni o'chirish yordam markaziga yo'naltiriladi.

rawFindings.title: Telegram ishlamaganda (503 TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE) ariza, vakansiya formasi, sharh va kompaniyaga yozish oqimlari Rule K xabarini ko'rsatmaydi
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 da requirePhoneVerified telefon tasdiqlanmagan va bot ishlamayotgan bo'lsa 403 o'rniga 503 TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE qaytaradigan bo'ldi, lekin umumiy isPhoneGateError() faqat PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED kodini taniydi. Faqat EmployerApplicationsView, candidates sahifasi va vacancyActionErrorKind 503 ni alohida qo'shgan; qolgan chaqiruvchilar yangilanmagan.
rawFindings.impact: Bot o'chiq paytda tasdiqlanmagan nomzod 'Ariza yuborish' bosganda, ish beruvchi vakansiya yaratganda/tahrirlaganda, nomzod sharh yozganda umumiy 'xatolik' yoki qayta urinish ko'rsatiladi; PhoneGateNotice (u o'zi status.available ni tekshirib Rule K matnini chiqaradi) umuman chizilmaydi. Rule K ('aniq UI xabari') buziladi, foydalanuvchi befoyda qayta urinadi.
rawFindings.evidence: auth-guard.ts:103-109 `if (!isTelegramAvailable()) throw new AppError(503, "TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE", ...)`; PhoneGateNotice.tsx:79-81 `return ... code === "PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED"`; lib/vacancies/useApplication.ts:78-82 (503 -> setError({kind:"failed"})); components/employer/vacancies/VacancyForm.tsx:224-229 (503 -> setFailure({message:null, retry:true})); components/companies/detail/CompanyReviews.tsx:114-115 (503 -> "failed"); components/companies/detail/CompanyActions.tsx:51.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: isPhoneGateError() ni TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE (yoki status 503 + shu kod) ni ham gate xatosi deb qaytaradigan qiling — PhoneGateNotice allaqachon available=false holatida Rule K matnini ko'rsatadi; EmployerApplicationsView va candidates sahifasidagi mahalliy isGateError nusxalarini shu umumiy funksiyaga almashtiring.

rawFindings.title: WebSocket xato kadrlari ({type:'error', code, clientId}) web tomonidan umuman o'qilmaydi — tasdiqlanmagan yoki limitga tushgan yuboruvchi 10 s kutib 'yuborilmadi' oladi va socket qayta ochiladi
rawFindings.rootCause: API Round 3 da WS xabar kadrlariga telefon gate'i, hisob bo'yicha kvota va xato kadrlari qo'shdi (PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED, RATE_LIMITED, FORBIDDEN, SERVER_ERROR), lekin useChatSocket.onmessage faqat 'message' va 'read' turlarini ishlaydi; useMessenger tasdiq kelmasa 10 s dan keyin pufakni 'failed' qiladi va socket.reset() bilan ulanishni yopadi.
rawFindings.impact: Ish beruvchi ochgan suhbatga (isOpenToWork nomzod telefon tasdiqlamagan bo'lishi mumkin) javob yozgan tasdiqlanmagan nomzod hech qachon 'telefoningizni tasdiqlang' xabarini ko'rmaydi: har urinish 10 s osilib 'yuborilmadi' bo'ladi va har safar ulanish uziladi. Tez yozganda RATE_LIMITED ham ulanishni qayta-qayta yopib, boshqa xabarlarning tasdig'ini yo'qotadi. Chat uchun bu xato kodlariga i18n kaliti ham yo'q.
rawFindings.evidence: chat.routes.ts:327-333 sendError -> `{ type: "error", code, clientId }`; :437,:443 RATE_LIMITED; :478 PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED; :487 SERVER_ERROR. useChatSocket.ts:145-148 faqat `data.type === "message"` va `data.type === "read"`; useMessenger.ts:450-458 timeout -> setStatus("failed") + `socketRef.current.reset()`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: useChatSocket'ga onError(code, clientId) handler qo'shing; useMessenger shu clientId bo'yicha taymerni to'xtatib pufakni darhol 'failed' qilsin, reset() chaqirmasin; PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED/TELEGRAM holatida suhbat oynasida PhoneGateNotice, RATE_LIMITED uchun tarjima qilingan qisqa xabar ko'rsating (uz/ru/en kalitlari bilan).

rawFindings.title: Har chiqishda (logout) server barcha push obunalarini o'chiradi, web esa brauzer obunasiga qarab 'yoqilgan' ko'rsatishda davom etadi — push jimgina ishlamay qoladi
rawFindings.rootCause: gap2-4 tuzatishi closeUserSockets() ichiga deleteUserPushSubscriptions() qo'ydi; revokeUserSessions() endi closeUserSockets() ni chaqiradi va logout aynan revokeUserSessions() orqali o'tadi. Web usePush holatni faqat navigator pushManager.getSubscription() dan oladi, kirishda serverga qayta obuna yubormaydi va logout'da sub.unsubscribe() qilmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Foydalanuvchi istalgan qurilmada bir marta chiqib qayta kirsa, barcha qurilmalarda push xabarnomalar to'xtaydi, sozlamalar sahifasi esa push'ni 'yoqilgan' deb ko'rsatadi — foydalanuvchi o'chirib-yoqmaguncha tiklanmaydi. Ariza holati va yangi arizalar haqidagi push kanali amalda yo'qoladi.
rawFindings.evidence: realtime.ts:86-87 `export function closeUserSockets(...) { void deleteUserPushSubscriptions(userId);`; auth.service.ts:184 `closeUserSockets(userId);` (revokeUserSessions ichida); auth.routes.ts:123 logout -> `await revokeUserSessions(payload.sub, payload.v);`; usePush.ts:63-65 `const sub = await reg?.pushManager.getSubscription(); setState(sub ? "on" : "off")` — server holati tekshirilmaydi.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Web: usePush ochilganda brauzerda obuna bo'lsa uni POST /api/push/subscribe bilan idempotent qayta ro'yxatdan o'tkazsin (yoki serverdan obuna holatini so'rasin); logout'da sub.unsubscribe() chaqirilsin. Yoki API: oddiy logout'da push obunalarini o'chirmay, faqat blok/parol tiklash/telefon almashtirishda o'chirsin va bu farqni hujjatlashtirsin.

rawFindings.title: D-074 web qismi yarim: vakansiya va kompaniya SSR so'rovlari x-ssr-key yubormaydi, umumiy IP bucket'iga tushadi
rawFindings.rootCause: ssrHeaders() faqat tryFetch (api.ts:91), articles/api.ts va fetchSalaryStats'ga ulangan. Eng og'ir SSR loaderlari ishlatadigan fetchVacancyPage, fetchVacancyFacets, fetchVacancyDetail, fetchSimilarVacancies, fetchCompanyPage, fetchCompanyDetail, fetchSimilarCompanies to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fetch() qiladi va sarlavhani qo'shmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Production'da /, /vacancies, /vacancies/:slug, /companies, /companies/:slug SSR so'rovlari bitta Vercel egress IP'dan 600/min umumiy limitga uriladi; crawl yoki trafik cho'qqisida 429 qaytib sahifalar xato holatida render bo'ladi. DEPLOY.md:80 esa SSR so'rovlari '429 bo'lmaydi' deb va'da qiladi — hujjat kodga zid.
rawFindings.evidence: api.ts:79-84 ssrHeaders(); api.ts:346 `fetch(`${API_URL}/api/vacancies?${params}`, { signal: withServerTimeout(signal) })`, :366 facets, :383 detail, :397 similar, :441-444 companies, :490 company detail, :506 similar companies — hech birida ssrHeaders() yo'q; pages/vacancies/+data.ts:25 va pages/index/+data.ts:16 shularni SSR'da chaqiradi; server.ts:167 `keyGenerator: (req) => (isSsrRequest(req) ? "ssr" : req.ip)`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Barcha ochiq SSR fetcherlarini tryFetch/umumiy yordamchi orqali o'tkazing yoki har biriga `headers: { ...ssrHeaders() }` qo'shing (fetchCompanyPage'da Authorization bilan birlashtirib); support/api.ts va fetchPlans ham shu yordamchidan foydalansin.

rawFindings.title: API yangi `isUnavailable` bayrog'ini qaytaradi, web uni o'qimaydi — moderatsiyadagi/rad etilgan vakansiya nomi va 'maosh yashirilgan' holati ko'rinaveradi
rawFindings.rootCause: GET /api/applications va GET /api/conversations vakansiya kartasiga isUnavailable qo'shdi va maoshni null qildi (moderatsiyada isSalaryHidden:true ham qo'yiladi), lekin mapMyApplication va conversation adapteri bu maydonni o'qimaydi — faqat status !== 'active' dan isClosed hisoblanadi.
rawFindings.impact: Nomzod arizalar ro'yxati va suhbat kartasida moderatsiyadagi/rad etilgan e'lonni 'yopilgan' va 'maosh kelishiladi' ko'rinishida, sarlavhasi bilan ko'radi; gap4-2 da ko'zlangan neytral 'e'lon mavjud emas' holati hech qayerda chizilmaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: applications.routes.ts:443-446 `{ ...row.vacancy, salaryMin: null, salaryMax: null, isSalaryHidden: true, isUnavailable: true }`; chat.routes.ts:767 `isUnavailable: vacancy.status === "moderation" || ...`; web: `grep isUnavailable apps/web/src` — natija yo'q; lib/api.ts:701 `isClosed: vacancy.status !== "active"`; lib/messages/adapter.ts:132 `isClosed: r.isClosed === true`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: MyApplication.vacancy va ConversationVacancy VM'lariga isUnavailable qo'shing; ApplicationCard va ConversationVacancyContext bu holatda sarlavha/maosh o'rniga tarjima qilingan neytral yozuv ko'rsatsin.

rawFindings.title: Kirish/ro'yxatdan o'tish/Google va nomzodlar kvotasi xatolarida serverning o'zbekcha matni ru/en da ko'rsatiladi; qo'shilgan t.errors.codes hech qayerda ishlatilmaydi va kodlari API'ga mos emas
rawFindings.rootCause: Round 3 yangi xato kodlarini qo'shdi (WEAK_PASSWORD, TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS login lockout va register kvotasi, GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_EXISTS, RATE_LIMITED kvota), web esa bu formalarda err.message ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqaradi. i18n'ga ApiErrorCode va errors.codes qo'shilgan, lekin chaqiruvchi yo'q; ro'yxatdagi INVALID_CREDENTIALS va EMAIL_TAKEN kodlarini login/register umuman qaytarmaydi (UNAUTHORIZED / CONFLICT).
rawFindings.impact: Rus va ingliz tilidagi foydalanuvchi 'Bu parol juda oson topiladi...', 'Juda ko'p so'rov...' kabi o'zbekcha matnlarni ko'radi; tarjima lug'ati o'lik kod bo'lib qolgan.
rawFindings.evidence: signup/+Page.tsx:57, login/+Page.tsx:71, SocialLogin.tsx:60 `setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : ...)`; pages/employer/candidates/+Page.tsx:35,197 kvota kartasida `state.message` (server matni); lib/i18n/types.ts:822-839 ApiErrorCode (INVALID_CREDENTIALS, EMAIL_TAKEN ...); `grep errors.codes|byCode` — faqat apiExtra.ts:117-121 da parametr, chaqiruvchi yo'q; API: auth.service.ts:49 `Errors.conflict(...)` (CONFLICT), :106,:112 `Errors.unauthorized(...)` (UNAUTHORIZED); password.ts WEAK_PASSWORD o'zbekcha xabar.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Login, signup, Google va candidates kvota kartasida apiErrorText(err, locale, { fallback, byCode: t.errors.codes }) dan foydalaning; ApiErrorCode ro'yxatini API haqiqatda qaytaradigan kodlarga moslang (UNAUTHORIZED, CONFLICT, GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_EXISTS qo'shing yoki API'da INVALID_CREDENTIALS/EMAIL_TAKEN kodlarini qaytaring).

rawFindings.title: apps/web/DESIGN.md Round 3 dan keyingi ma'lumot oqimlariga zid (to'liq ro'yxat, klientda filtr, limit=100, PDF yo'q)
rawFindings.rootCause: DESIGN.md Round 3 da (a11y, SocialLogin) tahrirlangan, lekin D-061, D-068/scale-10k-13, D-078 va D-058 bilan o'zgargan sahifa ma'lumot manbalari yangilanmagan.
rawFindings.impact: Keyingi dasturchi /employer/vacancies va /employer/applications ni 'hammasi bitta javobda, klientda filtr' deb, bildirishnomalarni 'limit=100, sahifalash yo'q' deb, ish beruvchida PDF rezyume yo'q deb o'ylaydi — kod bilan ziddiyatli o'zgartirishlar kiritishi mumkin.
rawFindings.evidence: DESIGN.md:123 "`GET /api/employer/vacancies` (hammasi bitta javobda)"; :124 statistika "ro'yxatdan hisoblanadi"; :144 "faqat faol↔yopilgan va qoralama→faol" (endi rejected/moderation → archived ham); :155 "(to'liq ro'yxat; qidiruv/filtr/sahifalash klientda)"; :165 "PDF rezyume/yuklab olish (backendda yo'q)"; :564 "`GET /api/notifications?limit=100` (backend chegarasi, sahifalash yo'q ...)" — kod: applications.routes.ts:458-547 server sahifalash, notifications.routes.ts:73-129 kursor, lib/notifications/api.ts:8 limit 50.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: DESIGN.md ning /employer/vacancies, /employer/applications va /notifications bo'limlarini joriy server-sahifalash, kursor ('Yana yuklash', 'Eskiroq xabarlar') va himoyalangan PDF (openProtectedFile) oqimiga moslab yangilang.

rawFindings.title: Bildirishnoma sozlamalari UI'si server semantikasiga mos emas: 'Tizim · sayt ichida' o'chirilsa ham moderatsiya/kompaniya xabarlari keladi, 'Tizim · Telegram' esa chat ogohlantirishlarini ham o'chiradi
rawFindings.rootCause: Sxemaga yangi NotificationType qo'shilmagani uchun API i18n kalit prefiksi bo'yicha (security./vacancy./company.) in-app'ni majburiy qildi va chat Telegram ogohlantirishini system+telegram sozlamasiga bog'ladi; sozlamalar matritsasi va UI esa o'zgarmadi, bu istisnolar hech qayerda ko'rsatilmaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Foydalanuvchi 'system/in_app' ni o'chirgan holda baribir bildirishnoma oladi (UI yolg'on); chat Telegram xabarlarini o'chirish uchun moderatsiya xabarlarini ham o'chirishga majbur, va aksincha — kutilmagan yon ta'sir.
rawFindings.evidence: notifications.service.ts:124 `const MANDATORY_IN_APP_PREFIXES = ["security.", "vacancy.", "company."]` va :168 `(c === "in_app" && mandatoryInApp)`; chat.routes.ts:157 `if (!(await isChannelEnabled(receiverId, "system", "telegram"))) return;`; NotificationSettings.tsx:15-16 turlar ro'yxati va :135-150 har katak oddiy almashtirgich, hech qanday izohsiz.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Qisqa muddatda: sozlamalarda system/in_app va system/telegram kataklariga tarjima qilingan izoh qo'shing (moderatsiya xabarlari doim keladi; Telegram'dagi 'tizim' chat ogohlantirishlarini ham boshqaradi). To'g'ri yechim — additiv NotificationType qiymatlari (moderation, security, new_message) va ularni matritsada ko'rsatish.

rawFindings.title: GET /api/applications jimgina 300 ta bilan kesiladi, web esa uni to'liq ro'yxat deb hisoblaydi
rawFindings.rootCause: Javob massiv bo'lib qolgani uchun kesilganlik belgisi yo'q; /applications sahifasi sonlar, tablar, 'eng eski' saralash va sahifalashni shu massiv ustida klientda hisoblaydi, useApplication esa vakansiya uchun arizani shu massivdan .find() qiladi.
rawFindings.impact: 300 dan ortiq arizasi bor nomzodda holat tablari va jami noto'g'ri, 'eng eski' saralash haqiqiy eng eskisini ko'rsatmaydi, eski arizali vakansiya sahifasida 'Ariza yuborildi' o'rniga 'Ariza yuborish' tugmasi chiqadi (bosilganda server mavjudini qaytaradi).
rawFindings.evidence: applications.routes.ts:46 `const MY_APPLICATIONS_LIMIT = 300;`, :439 `take: MY_APPLICATIONS_LIMIT` (javobda hech qanday flag yo'q); web lib/applications/query.ts:8-10 "`GET /api/applications` nomzodning barcha arizalarini bitta ro'yxatda qaytaradi"; lib/vacancies/useApplication.ts:48 `apps.value.find((a) => a.vacancy.id === vacancyId)`.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: GET /api/vacancies/:id/my-application (yoki ?vacancyId= filtri) qo'shib useApplication'ni unga o'tkazing; /api/applications ga kursor yoki kamida `truncated` belgisi qo'shing va sahifada 'oxirgi 300 ta' izohini ko'rsating.

rawFindings.title: Admin tiklash so'rovlarida 'expired' filtri hech qachon natija bermaydi, muddati o'tgan tasdiqlangan so'rov 'approved' bo'lib ko'rinadi
rawFindings.rootCause: RecoveryRequest.status hech qachon 'expired' ga yozilmaydi — faqat /manual/status javobida o'qish paytida hisoblanadi. Admin API continueExpiresAt ni qaytaradi, lekin web tipi va kartasi uni o'qimaydi.
rawFindings.impact: Admin 'Muddati o'tgan' filtrini tanlasa doim bo'sh ro'yxat ko'radi; 72 soati tugagan so'rovlar yashil 'Tasdiqlangan' nishoni bilan qoladi, admin foydalanuvchi hali davom ettira oladi deb o'ylaydi.
rawFindings.evidence: admin.routes.ts:767 filtr enumida "expired"; `grep '"expired"' apps/api/src` — faqat admin.routes.ts:767 va recovery.routes.ts:191 (`return { status: "expired" }`, bazaga yozilmaydi); RecoveryRequests.tsx:81 `{ value: "expired", ... }`, :307-313 StatusBadge approved -> yashil; lib/auth/recovery.ts RecoveryRequestItem'da continueExpiresAt yo'q.
rawFindings.recommendedFix: Admin ro'yxatida status=expired ni `status: approved AND continueExpiresAt < now` ga tarjima qiling va javobdagi approved qatorlar uchun muddati o'tganini 'expired' deb qaytaring (yoki web continueExpiresAt ni o'qib nishonni almashtirsin).

rawFindings.title: Suhbatlar ro'yxatida vakansiya konteksti kompaniya filtrini yo'qotdi va 1000 ta global chegaraga tushdi — karta jimgina yo'qolishi mumkin
rawFindings.rootCause: Kontekst endi sahifadagi nomzodlarning BARCHA kompaniyalarga bergan arizalaridan eng yangi 1000 tasini olib, keyin xotirada companyId bo'yicha filtrlaydi; baseline'da so'rov shu kompaniyalar vakansiyalari bilan cheklangan va chegarasiz edi.
rawFindings.impact: Ko'p joyga ariza yuboradigan nomzodlar bilan suhbatlashadigan ish beruvchida shu kompaniyaga berilgan arizalar 1000 lik oynadan tashqarida qolsa, suhbat kartasida vakansiya bloki bo'sh chiqadi yoki 'faol bosqich' ustunligi noto'g'ri arizani tanlaydi — xato emas, jim yo'qolish.
rawFindings.evidence: chat.routes.ts:683-708 `where: { jobSeekerId: { in: [...] } }`, `orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }`, `take: CONTEXT_APPLICATION_LIMIT` (250: 1000), :712 `if (!companyIds.has(application.vacancy.companyId)) continue;`; baseline chat.routes.ts:398-411 `vacancyId: { in: contextVacancyIds }` (kompaniya bo'yicha, take yo'q).
rawFindings.recommendedFix: So'rovga shu sahifadagi kompaniyalar vakansiyalari bo'yicha cheklov qaytaring (masalan har (seeker, company) jufti uchun alohida findFirst yoki companyId ro'yxati bilan vacancyId pre-resolve), yoki global take ni olib tashlang.

rawFindings.title: Oxirgi yuklangan bildirishnoma o'chirilgach 'Yana yuklash' eskirgan kursor bilan ketadi, API esa ID bo'yicha zaxira taqqoslashga o'tib yozuvlarni tashlab yuborishi mumkin
rawFindings.rootCause: Web nextCursor sifatida sahifadagi oxirgi qator ID'sini saqlaydi va remove() uni yangilamaydi. API anchor topilmasa createdAt bo'yicha tartiblangan ro'yxatga `id < before` filtrini qo'llaydi — ObjectId tartibi createdAt tartibiga teng bo'lmagan yozuvlarda (demo seed orqaga surilgan createdAt bilan yozadi) oyna noto'g'ri bo'ladi.
