issues.title: Parol tiklash, admin qo'lda tiklashni tasdiqlashi, telefon almashtirish va Telegram'ni uzish foydalanuvchining boshqa ochiq challenge'lari va berilgan reset tokenlarini bekor qilmaydi
issues.rootCause: cancelOpenChallenges butun kodda faqat bir joyda chaqiriladi: /recovery/reset ichida va faqat password_recovery hamda manual_recovery maqsadlari bilan (kontrakt ham shunchalik tor yozilgan). phone_change, backup_phone va telegram_link challenge'lari (pending yoki awaiting_contact) hamda eski identity'ga berilgan verified reset tokenlari tirik qoladi. Admin approve, applyPhoneChange, DELETE /api/telegram/link va revokeUserSessions challenge'larga tegmaydi. Challenge yaratilgan paytdagi tokenVersion yoki passwordChangedAt saqlanmaydi. Bot (handleStart/handleContact) va consumeResetToken hisob holati o'zgarganini tekshirmaydi.
issues.impact: Parolni bilgan hujumchi (masalan phishing orqali) POST /api/auth/phone/change bilan havola oladi va uni o'z Telegram'ida awaiting_contact holatiga keltiradi. Egasi parolni Telegram orqali tiklaydi va seanslar tugaydi, lekin hujumchining havolasi 15 daqiqa ishlab turadi. Hujumchi kontakt yuborsa, applyPhoneChange asosiy raqam va identity'ni unga o'tkazadi va egasining seanslarini tugatadi. So'ng hujumchi /recovery/start bilan parolni o'zi tiklaydi va hisobni to'liq egallaydi. Xuddi shunday, admin qo'lda tiklashni tasdiqlab kanallarni tozalagandan keyin ham o'g'irlangan Telegram'ga oldin berilgan verified reset tokeni parol o'rnata oladi. Ochiq telegram_link yoki phone_change challenge'i esa hujumchining raqamini tozalangan hisobga yozadi. Telefon almashtirilgach, eski identity'ga berilgan reset havolasi ham 15 daqiqa amal qiladi. 'Reset barcha seans va tokenlarni bekor qiladi' qoidasi va D-049 dagi 'tiklash kanallari tozalanadi' talabi buziladi.
issues.evidence: recovery.routes.ts:124 `await cancelOpenChallenges(user.id, ["password_recovery", "manual_recovery"]);`. grep bo'yicha cancelOpenChallenges faqat challenges.ts:102 (ta'rif) va recovery.routes.ts:15,124 da uchraydi. admin.routes.ts:861-875 approve: `prisma.user.update({ ... phone: null, isPhoneVerified: false, telegramChatId: null, backupPhone: null, backupTelegramId: null }); await revokeUserSessions(user.id);` — challenge bekor qilinmaydi. telegram.service.ts:521-558 applyPhoneChange: `data: { phone, isPhoneVerified: true, phoneVerifiedAt: new Date(), telegramChatId: fromId }` va :558 `await revokeUserSessions(user.id);`, boshqa challenge'lar qoladi. telegram.routes.ts:69 unlink: `prisma.user.update({ where: { id: userId }, data: { telegramChatId: null } })`. challenges.ts:84-90 latestAwaitingContact faqat `status: "awaiting_contact", expiresAt: { gt: new Date() }` bilan qidiradi. challenges.ts:129-133 findValidResetChallenge faqat resetTokenHash, resetExpiresAt va status'ni tekshiradi. telegram.service.ts:316-347 handleStart: isBlocked va telegramOwner tekshiriladi, tokenVersion tekshirilmaydi. auth_contract.md:113 'cancel other open recovery/manual challenges of the user' — kontraktning o'zi tor.
issues.recommendedFix: /recovery/reset da `cancelOpenChallenges(user.id)` ni maqsad filtrisiz chaqiring (iste'mol qilingan challenge allaqachon completed). Xuddi shu chaqiruvni admin approve'ga (user.update'dan oldin), applyPhoneChange'ga (completeChallenge'dan keyin), DELETE /api/telegram/link'ga va admin bloklashga qo'shing. Eng oddiy yo'l — uni revokeUserSessions ichiga qo'yish. Qo'shimcha himoya: AuthChallenge'ga additiv `tokenVersion` maydonini qo'shing, yaratishda joriy qiymatni yozing va handleStart/handleContact hamda consumeResetToken'da joriy qiymat bilan solishtiring. Farq bo'lsa MSG_INVALID yoki RESET_TOKEN_INVALID qaytsin. auth_contract.md:113 va D-045 matnini yangilang. e2e qo'shing: reset'dan keyin eski phone_change havolasi va approve'dan oldingi reset tokeni rad etilishi kerak.
issues.severityNote: To'rtta xom topilma bitta ildizga birlashtirildi. P1 saqlandi: hujum uchun parol yoki eski Telegram egaligi oldindan kerak bo'lgani uchun P0 emas, lekin egasining tiklash harakati (parolni tiklash, admin tasdig'i) hujumchini chiqarib yubora olmaydi — auth qoidasi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri buziladi.

vote.reasoning:
I read the current tree and every factual claim in the issue holds. The main attack works end to end, and nothing else in the flow stops it.

1. The only place a challenge is ever cancelled is /recovery/reset, and it cancels only the password_recovery and manual_recovery purposes (recovery.routes.ts:124). Admin approve (admin.routes.ts:861-875), applyPhoneChange (telegram.service.ts:538-558), DELETE /api/telegram/link (telegram.routes.ts:69), DELETE /api/auth/phone/backup (phone.routes.ts:76-80) and revokeUserSessions (auth.service.ts:174-186) never touch AuthChallenge.

2. Challenges and reset tokens carry no snapshot of account state such as tokenVersion. findOpenChallenge only checks for pending status and expiry (challenges.ts:66-73). latestAwaitingContact only checks awaiting_contact status and expiry (challenges.ts:84-90). findValidResetChallenge only checks the hash, expiry and verified status (challenges.ts:129-134). handleStart and handleContact re-check only isBlocked, telegramOwner and phoneOwner (telegram.service.ts:316-329, 452-469). /recovery/reset re-checks only isBlocked (recovery.routes.ts:105-109).

3. The takeover path, step by step:
   - The attacker knows the password and has a session. They call POST /api/auth/phone/change and get a pending phone_change link (phone.routes.ts:43).
   - The quota is 5 per 15 minutes per user (reauth.ts:50), so the attacker can create a fresh 15-minute link every 3 minutes and always hold one with most of its time left.
   - The owner resets the password through Telegram. The phone_change challenge is not cancelled because of the purpose filter.
   - The attacker opens the stashed link in their own Telegram. The challenge is still pending and unexpired, telegramOwner finds no conflict, and it moves to awaiting_contact.
   - The attacker sends their contact. applyPhoneChange sets phone and telegramChatId to the attacker (telegram.service.ts:543-546) and revokes the owner's sessions (:558). The old primary chat gets no notice.
   - The attacker calls /recovery/start with their own number. It finds the primary account because the phone is verified and telegramChatId is the attacker's (recovery.routes.ts:65-68). handleRecoveryStart compares the identity with telegramChatId and it matches (telegram.service.ts:384-385). The attacker sets a new password.
   - Result: full account takeover. The owner's reset did not evict the attacker, which breaks the rule that a reset invalidates all sessions and tokens.

4. The secondary claims also hold:
   - A verified reset token issued before an admin approve, a phone change or a Telegram unlink stays usable for up to 15 minutes, because /recovery/reset does not check the current identity.
   - An open telegram_link or phone_change challenge survives approve. After approve the phone fields are null, so the guards in applyTelegramLink and applyPhoneChange pass and write the attacker's number onto the cleaned account. This defeats the channel clearing that D-049 requires.

Where the issue overstates things:
   - The code matches the literal contract (auth_contract.md: "cancel other open recovery/manual challenges of the user") and the D-045 wording ("tiklash challenge'lari"). The gap is in the contract, not a missed implementation step. It is still a real security hole against the auth rule.
   - Adding the cancel call to admin block is unnecessary. Blocking is already enforced by the isBlocked checks in handleStart, handleContact, handleRecoveryStart and /recovery/reset.
   - The reset-token-survives-approve or phone-change sub-scenarios add little on their own: an attacker holding the Telegram could have reset earlier anyway.

P1 fits: the attack needs a prior compromise (password or old Telegram), so it is not P0. But the attacker can keep the window open indefinitely with rolling phone_change links, and it defeats the owner's own remediation (password reset, manual recovery).
vote.evidence:
apps/api/src/modules/auth/recovery.routes.ts:124 `await cancelOpenChallenges(user.id, ["password_recovery", "manual_recovery"]);` — the only call site (grep: challenges.ts:102 is the definition, recovery.routes.ts:15 is the import, :124 is the call).
apps/api/src/modules/auth/challenges.ts:66-73 findOpenChallenge checks only `status !== "pending"` and `expiresAt`; :84-90 latestAwaitingContact `where: { telegramUserId, status: "awaiting_contact", expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } }`; :129-134 findValidResetChallenge `where: { resetTokenHash, resetExpiresAt: { gt }, status: "verified" }`. No tokenVersion or passwordChangedAt snapshot (schema.prisma has tokenVersion only on User, :171).
apps/api/src/modules/auth/phone.routes.ts:43 `createChallenge({ purpose: "phone_change", userId })`; reauth.ts:50 `assertQuota(\`phoneflow:user:${userId}\`, 5, QUARTER_HOUR_MS)`, which allows rolling 15-minute links.
apps/api/src/modules/telegram/telegram.service.ts:316-350 handleStart: isBlocked, telegramOwner, then markAwaitingContact, with no account-version check; :436-469 handleContact: latestAwaitingContact, isBlocked, phoneOwner; :543-546 applyPhoneChange `data: { phone, isPhoneVerified: true, phoneVerifiedAt: new Date(), telegramChatId: fromId }`, :558 `await revokeUserSessions(user.id);`, and no cancellation of other challenges or reset tokens.
apps/api/src/modules/auth/recovery.routes.ts:65-68 primary lookup `{ phone: normalized, isPhoneVerified: true, isBlocked: false, telegramChatId: { not: null } }`, which the attacker satisfies after the phone change; telegram.service.ts:384-385 identity check against the current telegramChatId.
apps/api/src/modules/admin/admin.routes.ts:862-875 approve clears phone, isPhoneVerified, telegramChatId, backupPhone and backupTelegramId, then runs revokeUserSessions, with no challenge cancellation.
apps/api/src/modules/telegram/telegram.routes.ts:69 `prisma.user.update({ where: { id: userId }, data: { telegramChatId: null } })`, with no challenge or reset-token cancellation.
apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts:174-186 revokeUserSessions only bumps tokenVersion and closes sockets.
apps/api/src/modules/auth/recovery.routes.ts:103-114 reset re-checks only `user.isBlocked`, not the current identity.
apps/api/scripts/auth-telegram-check.mjs:910-931 tests only stale password_recovery tokens; there is no test for phone_change, telegram_link or backup challenges after a reset or approve.
Contract and decision scope: auth_contract.md "cancel other open recovery/manual challenges of the user"; DECISIONS.md D-045 "foydalanuvchining boshqa ochiq tiklash challenge'lari bekor qilinadi".

issues.title: Ish beruvchi rad etilgan yoki moderatsiyadagi e'lonni yopganda qulf holati izchil saqlanmaydi: eski e'lonlarda moderatsiya chetlab o'tiladi, yangilarida e'lon qotib qoladi
issues.rootCause: employer-flows-15 egasiga rejected/moderation → archived o'tishini qo'shdi, lekin e'lon moderatsiyadan o'tmaganini alohida belgilamadi: qulf faqat `adminArchivedAt` ga bog'liq. Egasi yopganda bu maydon o'zgarmaydi (502-qator uni faqat admin uchun yozadi). archived → active o'tishi esa faqat shu maydonni tekshiradi (483). Round 3 dan oldingi rad etilgan va moderatsiyadagi e'lonlarda hamda demo seed'da `adminArchivedAt` yo'q (D-067 bo'yicha backfill qilinmaydi), shuning uchun ular qulfsiz arxivga tushadi. Round 3 dan keyin rad etilganlarida esa qulf bor, lekin PUT qayta yuborishni faqat `status === "rejected"` bo'lganda bajaradi (417). Natijada archived+qulf holatidan chiqish yo'li yo'q.
issues.impact: (1) Moderatsiyani chetlab o'tish: ish beruvchi eski rad etilgan yoki moderatsiyadagi e'lonni 'Yopish' va keyin 'Faollashtirish' tugmalari (ikki PATCH /status) bilan admin tasdig'isiz saytga chiqaradi. Bu demo HR kompaniyasining moderation/rejected e'lonlarida va production'dagi barcha eski shunday e'lonlarda takrorlanadi. 'Moderatsiyani chetlab o'tib bo'lmaydi' qoidasi buziladi. (2) Round 3 dan keyin rad etilgan e'lonni egasi yopsa, uni tuzatib qayta yuborib ham, faollashtirib ham bo'lmaydi: tahrir saqlanadi, lekin holat o'zgarmaydi va xato ham chiqmaydi. E'lonni faqat admin tiklay oladi.
issues.evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:473-476 `allowedFrom = { active: ["archived", "draft"], archived: ["active", "rejected", "moderation"] }` (baseline: `archived: ["active"]`). :483 `if (!isAdmin) assertNotAdminLocked(vacancy);`. :501-502 `...(status === "active" ? { adminArchivedAt: null } : {}), ...(status === "archived" && isAdmin ? { adminArchivedAt: new Date() } : {})`. :417 `const resubmit = vacancy.status === "rejected" && req.user!.role !== "admin";`. :445 resubmit `status: "moderation"` yozadi, adminArchivedAt'ga tegmaydi. demo-seed.ts:486,556,660 `status: "moderation"`, :492,772 `status: "rejected"`, faylda `adminArchivedAt` umuman yozilmaydi. web lib/employer/vacancies/adapter.ts:108-109 `close: ... || v.status === "rejected" || v.status === "moderation"`, `activate: (v.status === "archived" || v.status === "draft") && !v.adminLocked`.
issues.recommendedFix: Egasi rejected yoki moderation holatidagi e'lonni yopganda qulfni majburan qo'ying: `adminArchivedAt: vacancy.adminArchivedAt ?? new Date()`, chunki bunday e'lonni faqat admin chop etishi mumkin. PUT'dagi `resubmit` shartini archived+qulfli e'longa ham kengaytiring (`vacancy.status === "rejected" || (vacancy.status === "archived" && vacancy.adminArchivedAt)`); natija `active` emas, `moderation` bo'lsin. Web `vacancyCapabilities` qulfli yopiq e'lon uchun 'Tahrirlab qayta yuborish' yo'lini ko'rsatsin. e2e: rejected→archived→active va moderation→archived→active 409 VACANCY_LOCKED qaytarishi, archived+qulfli e'lonni PUT qilish esa moderation'ga o'tkazishi kerak.
issues.severityNote: authz-idor-2-1 (P1) va data-integrity-2-12 (P3) bitta o'tishdan chiqadi: qulf maydoni bor-yo'qligiga qarab ikki xil nosozlik beradi. Kuchlisi bo'yicha P1: chetlab o'tish eski va demo ma'lumotda hozir takrorlanadi.

vote.reasoning:
Mexanizm joriy kodda to'liq tasdiqlandi, lekin P1 og'irligi oshirib ko'rsatilgan.

(1) Chetlab o'tish haqiqatan bor. PATCH /status endi ish beruvchiga rejected/moderation → archived o'tishiga ruxsat beradi (vacancies.routes.ts:473-476). Baseline'da faqat `archived: ["active"]` edi, ya'ni bu yo'lni Round 3 ochgan. archived → active o'tishini faqat `assertNotAdminLocked` to'sadi (483, 164-171), u esa faqat `adminArchivedAt` ga qaraydi. Egasi yopganda bu maydon yozilmaydi (501-502). Baseline sxemada maydon bor edi, lekin baseline kodi uni hech qachon yozmagan. D-067 backfill qilmaydi, demo-seed.ts:486,492,556,660,772 esa rejected/moderation e'lonlarni `adminArchivedAt` siz yaratadi. Demak eski va demo e'lonlar qulfsiz: PATCH archived, keyin PATCH active qilinsa, e'lon admin tasdig'isiz chiqadi. Masalan "UX tadqiqotchi" e'loni: type remote, joylashuv tekshiruvidan o'tadi. Remote bo'lmagan e'londa esa avval PUT bilan workplaceType to'ldiriladi. Web ham ikkala tugmani ko'rsatadi: adapter.ts:108-109. Round 3 dan keyingi rad etishlar himoyalangan. admin.routes.ts:449 qulf qo'yadi, PUT resubmit (vacancies.routes.ts:417, 445) esa qulfni tozalamaydi, shuning uchun moderation holatidagi e'lon ham qulfli qoladi. Admin endpoint'i "moderation" holatini qo'ya olmaydi (406-qator), boshqa rad etish yo'li ham yo'q.

Og'irlikni pasaytiradigan fakt: platforma post-moderatsiya bilan ishlaydi. POST /api/vacancies sukut bo'yicha darhol `active` e'lon yaratadi (vacancies.service.ts:765, 788-789; routes 85, 389), faol e'lonni PUT qilish ham qayta ko'rikdan o'tmaydi. Ya'ni ish beruvchi rad etilgan matnni yangi e'lon sifatida baribir darhol chiqara oladi. Bu chetlab o'tish unga yangi imkoniyat bermaydi, faqat eski e'lonni (slug/tarix bilan) admin qarorisiz qaytaradi. Admin uni qayta rad etsa, e'lon endi qulflanadi. Buzilish faqat qulfsiz eski yoki demo yozuvlarda takrorlanadi. Shuning uchun P2: qoida rasman buziladi, ta'siri cheklangan.

(2) "Qotib qolish" ham to'g'ri. Round 3 da rad etilgan va qulflangan e'lonni egasi yopsa, uni faollashtirishga urinish 409 VACANCY_LOCKED beradi. PUT faqat `status === "rejected"` da qayta yuboradi (417), shuning uchun tahrir 200 bilan saqlanadi, holat esa archived bo'lib qoladi. Web qulfli arxiv uchun hech qanday amal ko'rsatmaydi. Lekin bu egasining o'zi yopgan e'loni, u yangi e'lon yarata oladi, admin esa tiklay oladi. Bu P3 darajasidagi UX kamchiligi.

Tavsiya etilgan tuzatish to'g'ri yo'nalishda: egasi rejected/moderation holatidagi e'lonni yopganda `adminArchivedAt: vacancy.adminArchivedAt ?? new Date()` yozilsin, archived+qulfli e'lon PUT qilinganda moderation'ga o'tsin.

issues.title: D-074 yarim bajarilgan: asosiy SSR fetch'lari x-ssr-key yubormaydi, bosh sahifa, vakansiya va kompaniya sahifalari hanuz IP bo'yicha 600/min bucket'iga tushadi
issues.rootCause: ssrHeaders() faqat tryFetch (api.ts:89-91), lib/articles/api.ts:18-21 va fetchSalaryStats (apiExtra.ts:408-410) ichiga qo'shilgan. SSR loader'lar ishlatadigan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fetch'lar kalitsiz qolgan: fetchVacancyPage, fetchVacancyFacets, fetchVacancyDetail, fetchSimilarVacancies, fetchCompanyPage, fetchCompanyDetail, fetchSimilarCompanies, lib/support/api.ts request() va api/seo.js proksisi.

Umumiy Vercel egress IP'dan daqiqasiga 600 dan ko'p so'rov kelsa (crawl yoki o'rtacha trafik), API 429 qaytaradi. Round 3 da bu 429 SSR paytida 503 render'ga aylantirilgan, shuning uchun foydalanuvchi va Googlebot eng muhim sahifalarda 503 oladi. API tomondagi 6000/min 'ssr' bucket'i amalda deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

Xuddi shunday api.ts:366 (facets), :383 (detail), :397 (similar), :442 (companies, faqat Authorization), :490 (company detail), :506 (similar companies). support/api.ts:13 `res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, init);`. Taqqoslash uchun api.ts:89-91 tryFetch: `headers: { ...(init?.headers ...), ...ssrHeaders() }`. API server.ts:167 `keyGenerator: (req) => (isSsrRequest(req) ? "ssr" : req.ip)`. wave1_summary: 'contract:D-074-ssr-key | PARTIAL' va needsOutside'da aynan shu yetti fetch sanab o'tilgan.
issues.recommendedFix: ssrHeaders() ni SSR'da ishlaydigan barcha fetch'larga qo'shing, yaxshisi bitta umumiy serverFetch yordamchisi orqali: fetchVacancyPage, fetchVacancyFacets, fetchVacancyDetail, fetchSimilarVacancies, fetchCompanyPage (Authorization bilan birlashtirib), fetchCompanyDetail, fetchSimilarCompanies, lib/support/api.ts request() va api/seo.js dagi upstream fetch. Web unit-check'ga SSR rejimida bu funksiyalar x-ssr-key yuborishini tekshiradigan test qo'shing. apps/web/.env.example ga SSR_API_KEY izohini yozing.
issues.severityNote: P1 saqlandi. ISSUE-150 va scale-10k-1 P1 sifatida FIXED deb belgilangan, lekin fix eng ko'p trafikli yo'llarda kuchga kirmagan. Round 3 da 429 SSR'da 503 ga aylangani uchun oqibat ko'proq ko'rinadi. Muammoning o'zi Round 3 dan oldin ham bor edi.

vote.reasoning:
Da'vo hozirgi kodda to'liq tasdiqlandi. Uni rad etishga urinib ko'rdim, lekin bo'lmadi.

1) ssrHeaders() (apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:79-84) faqat quyidagi uch joyda ishlatiladi: tryFetch (api.ts:91), lib/articles/api.ts:20 va apiExtra.ts:409 (fetchSalaryStats). Shu uch joydan boshqa hech qaerda chaqirilmaydi. Vakansiya va kompaniya fetch'lari faqat withServerTimeout() bilan chaqiriladi, ularda x-ssr-key yo'q.

2) Header'ni boshqa yo'l bilan qo'shadigan mexanizm ham yo'q. globalThis.fetch patch qilinmagan. api/ssr.js va server/index.mjs faqat renderPage() ni chaqiradi. apps/web ichida "x-ssr-key" yoki "SSR_API_KEY" faqat lib/api.ts da uchraydi.

3) Kalitsiz fetch'larni SSR +data hook'lari to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chaqiradi:
- pages/index/+data.ts:18,22,26 (fetchVacancyPage, fetchCompanyPage, fetchVacancyFacets). Kalit faqat fetchStats'da bor, u tryFetch orqali ketadi.
- pages/vacancies/+data.ts:26-27
- pages/vacancies/@slug/+data.ts:22,29
- pages/companies/+data.ts:24-25 (fetchFeaturedCompanies ham fetchCompanyPage orqali ketadi)
- pages/companies/@slug/+data.ts:20,27
- pages/contact/+data.ts support/api.ts request() orqali (support/api.ts:13)

4) API tomonida server.ts:167 da `keyGenerator: (req) => (isSsrRequest(req) ? "ssr" : req.ip)` turibdi, 6000 limit faqat "ssr" kaliti uchun beriladi, qolganlarga env.RATE_LIMIT_MAX (default 600, env.ts:56). Demak bu so'rovlar IP bucket'iga tushadi.

5) 429 SSR'da 503 ga aylanadi. fetchVacancyPage va fetchCompanyPage !res.ok bo'lsa ApiError uloqtiradi, loader uni null qiladi va `throw render(503)` chaqiriladi (index +data:28, vacancies +data:29, companies +data:27). fetchVacancyDetail va fetchCompanyDetail 429 da ApiError beradi, natijada failed=true va render(503) (vacancies/@slug:33, companies/@slug:30).

6) wave1_summary.md:611 D-074 ni "PARTIAL" deb qayd etgan, :616 va :627 da aynan shu yetti fetch sanab o'tilgan. wave2_summary'da bu ish bajarilgani haqida hech qanday yozuv yo'q, kod ham o'zgarmagan.

Severity bo'yicha bir izoh: Vercel serverless egress IP'lari bitta emas, AWS pulidan keladi. Shuning uchun Vercel'da limitga urilish ehtimoli da'vodagidan biroz pastroq. Lekin DEPLOY.md self-hosted web serverni ham ko'zda tutadi, u holda barcha SSR trafigi bitta IP'dan chiqadi. Bosh sahifaning bitta render'i IP bucket'iga 3 ta kalitsiz so'rov yuboradi, vakansiya sahifasi 2 ta. Demak daqiqasiga taxminan 200-300 sahifa ko'rishdayoq 600/min limit tugaydi va eng muhim ochiq sahifalar 503 beradi. Bu D-074 qarori bajarilmagani va scale-10k-1 (P1) aslida yopilmagani demak. P1 saqlanadi.

Kichik qo'shimchalar:

issues.title: Web CSP dagi object-src 'none' blob: orqali ochilgan PDF rezyumeni Chrome/Edge PDF ko'ruvchisida bloklashi mumkin (D-057 va D-058 bir-biriga zid)
issues.rootCause: D-058 bo'yicha rezyume fetch bilan olinadi va yangi oyna ilova origin'ida yaratilgan blob: URL'ga o'tkaziladi. blob: hujjati uni yaratgan sahifaning policy container'ini (CSP) meros oladi, u yerda esa `object-src 'none'` bor. Chromium to'liq sahifali PDF'ni plagin (embed) sifatida ochadi va uni object-src tekshiruviga bo'ysundiradi. API jamoasi aynan shu sabab bilan API CSP'da `objectSrc: ['self']` ni qoldirgan, web siyosatida esa bu hisobga olinmagan.
issues.impact: Chrome yoki Edge'da nomzod o'z PDF rezyumesini, ish beruvchi esa nomzodning PDF'ini ochganda yangi oyna bo'sh yoki kulrang qolishi mumkin. fetch muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgani uchun UI hech qanday xato ko'rsatmaydi. Ish beruvchi uchun asosiy oqim — nomzod CV'sini ko'rish — buziladi. Brauzer regressiyasi o'tkazilmagan.
issues.evidence: +headersResponse.ts:52 `directive("object-src", "'none'")`. lib/files/resume.ts:53 `const tab = window.open("", "_blank");`, :74-75 `const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob); if (tab) tab.location.replace(objectUrl);`. apps/api/src/server.ts:126-127 `// Brauzerning o'z PDF ko'ruvchisi uchun ... objectSrc: ["'self'"]`. wave1_summary:756 va 769 bu xavfni ochiq deb qayd etgan va 'object-src 'self' blob:' ni tavsiya qilgan.
issues.recommendedFix: Web siyosatida `object-src` ni `blob:` ga o'zgartiring (yoki `'self' blob:`). Shunda faqat sahifa skripti o'zi yaratgan blob'lar ruxsat oladi, tashqi plagin manbalari yopiq qoladi. Keyin Chrome, Edge, Firefox va Safari'da ikkala tugmani (ResumeFile va employer ApplicationDetail) sinab, konsolda CSP xatosi yo'qligini tekshiring. Muqobil yo'l: inline ko'rish o'rniga doim yuklab olish (`a.download`).
issues.severityNote: P1 saqlandi, chunki ta'siri asosiy oqimga tegadi. Lekin ishonch o'rtacha: brauzerda sinalmagan. Tuzatishdan oldin Chrome'da bir marta tekshirish kerak. Tuzatishning o'zi (object-src blob:) xavfi past.

vote.reasoning:
Koddagi har bir dalil to'g'ri, lekin brauzerdagi oqibat faqat ehtimol va ta'sir doirasi oshirib ko'rsatilgan.

Nima tasdiqlandi:
1) Prod'da web CSP'da `object-src 'none'` bor. `+csp.ts` nonce'ni faqat dev bo'lmaganda beradi, `+headersResponse.ts` esa CSP'ni faqat nonce bo'lsa qo'yadi. Demak dev'da muammo umuman ko'rinmaydi. Brauzer regressiyasi o'tkazilmagan: e2e_final.log'da faqat API tomonidagi D-058 tekshiruvlari bor.
2) `openProtectedFile` oynani `noopener`siz ochadi (`window.open("", "_blank")`), blob'ni web origin'ida yaratadi va shu oynani `tab.location.replace(objectUrl)` bilan blob: ga o'tkazadi. Navigatsiyani boshlagan (initiator) ham, blob'ni yaratgan (creator) ham asosiy sahifa. Mahalliy sxemadagi (about/blob/data) hujjatlar CSP'ni shu kontekstdan meros oladi. Shuning uchun PDF hujjatiga `object-src 'none'` o'tadi.
3) Ichki ziddiyat haqiqiy. API jamoasi aynan brauzerning PDF ko'ruvchisi uchun `objectSrc: ["'self'"]` ni qoldirgan (server.ts:126-127). Ya'ni loyihaning o'zi "PDF hujjatiga object-src tatbiq qilinadi" deb hisoblaydi, web siyosati esa buni hisobga olmaydi. `'self'` blob: URL'ga mos kelmaydi, shuning uchun hatto `'self'` ham yetmasdi, `blob:` aniq yozilishi kerak.
4) Fetch muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa, promise resolve bo'ladi va UI xato ko'rsatmaydi. Zaxira yuklab olish faqat popup bloklanganda ishlaydi.

Nima tasdiqlanmadi yoki oshirib ko'rsatilgan:
- Chromium'ning to'liq sahifali PDF'ni `<embed>` orqali ochib, uni object-src bilan tekshirishini koddan isbotlab bo'lmaydi. Wave1'dagi ikki reviewer bu masalada kelishmagan. 246-qatordagisi "Chrome and Firefox do not apply object-src to a top-level P..." deb past baho bergan, 756-qatordagisi medium bergan. Firefox'dagi pdf.js plagin emas, unga ta'sir yo'q. Demak "Chrome/Edge'da bo'sh oyna" o'rtacha ishonchli taxmin, isbotlangan nosozlik emas.
- "Ish beruvchining asosiy oqimi buziladi" degan da'vo ortiqcha. ApplicationDetail.tsx'da ResumePanel PDF tugmasidan tashqari tuzilgan rezyumeni (`a.resume`: title, maosh va h.k.) baribir ko'rsatadi. PDF ixtiyoriy ilova, faqat `hasResumeFile` bo'lganda chiqadi. Nomzodni ko'rib chiqish to'liq to'xtamaydi, faqat biriktirilgan PDF'ni inline ochish yo'qolishi mumkin.

Xulosa: bu haqiqiy xavf. CSP siyosati D-058 oqimiga moslashtirilmagan va tuzatish arzon: `object-src 'self' blob:` yoki `blob:`, yoki inline ko'rish o'rniga doim `a.download`. Lekin brauzerda tasdiqlanmagan va ta'sir cheklangan, shuning uchun P1 emas, P2 to'g'riroq.

apps/web/src/pages/+headersResponse.ts:52 `directive("object-src", "'none'")`; :68-69 `const nonce = pageContext.cspNonce; if (nonce) headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = ...` (CSP faqat prod'da).
apps/web/src/pages/+csp.ts: `nonce: !import.meta.env.DEV` (dev'da CSP yo'q, muammo lokal ko'rinmaydi).
apps/web/src/lib/files/resume.ts:53 `const tab = window.open("", "_blank");` (noopener yo'q); :73-75 `const blob = await res.blob(); const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob); if (tab) tab.location.replace(objectUrl);`; :76 `else downloadFallback(objectUrl);` (zaxira faqat popup bloklanganda).
apps/api/src/server.ts:126-127 `// Brauzerning o'z PDF ko'ruvchisi uchun (rezyume Content-Disposition: inline bilan beriladi)` / `objectSrc: ["'self'"],`. Bu ichki ziddiyat: API PDF ko'ruvchi uchun object-src'ni ochiq qoldirgan, web esa 'none'.

Mutaxassislar kelishmagan, brauzerda tekshiruv yo'q (e2e_final.log'da faqat API tomonidagi D-058 tekshiruvlari).

issues.title: POST /api/telegram/link parol so'ramaydi: o'g'irlangan seans telefoni tasdiqlanmagan hisobga o'z Telegram tiklash kanalini bog'lab, parolni tiklaydi va hisobni butunlay egallaydi
issues.rootCause: Round 3 da Telegram bog'lanishi parol tiklash kanaliga aylandi: /recovery/start `isPhoneVerified + telegramChatId` bo'yicha ishlaydi. Lekin birinchi bog'lash faqat requireAuth bilan, joriy parolsiz qoldi. reauth.ts dagi 'o'g'irlangan seans tiklash kanalini o'zgartira olmasin' qoidasi faqat phone/change, backup va unlink uchun qo'llangan. Kontrakt ham bu endpointni parolsiz belgilagan.
issues.impact: Seans tokeni yoki refresh cookie'si o'g'irlangan (XSS, umumiy kompyuter; D-079 ochiq risk) va telefoni hali tasdiqlanmagan hisobda hujumchi o'z Telegram'ini va raqamini asosiy identity qilib bog'laydi. Keyin /recovery/start orqali reset havolasini o'z Telegram'iga olib, parolni almashtiradi. Egasining barcha seanslari tugaydi va u faqat admin orqali qo'lda tiklash bilan qaytishi mumkin. Vaqtinchalik seans o'g'irligi doimiy hisob egallashiga aylanadi.
issues.evidence: telegram.routes.ts:39-60: `app.post("/api/telegram/link", { preHandler: [requireAuth], ...phoneFlowLimit }, ...)` — `assertPhoneFlowQuota` va `assertTelegramAvailable` dan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri `createChallenge({ purpose: "telegram_link", userId })`, verifyCurrentPassword yo'q. Taqqoslang: telegram.routes.ts:67 unlink va phone.routes.ts change/backup `await verifyCurrentPassword(userId, password)` chaqiradi. reauth.ts:10-11 izohi. telegram.service.ts:485-509 applyTelegramLink tasdiqlangan raqam bo'lmasa `phone, isPhoneVerified: true, telegramChatId: fromId` yozadi. recovery.routes.ts:65-66 tiklash `isPhoneVerified: true, telegramChatId: { not: null }` bo'yicha.
issues.recommendedFix: Parol o'rnatilgan hisoblarda POST /api/telegram/link ham `{ password }` qabul qilsin va verifyCurrentPassword orqali tekshirsin. Google orqali yaratilgan, parolini bilmaydigan hisoblarni ajratish uchun additiv `passwordSetAt`/`hasPassword` belgisi kerak. Kamida birinchi bog'lashdan keyingi 24 soat ichida shu kanal orqali parol tiklash taqiqlansin. Kontrakt parolsiz variantni belgilagani uchun qaror DECISIONS'ga (D-044 yangilanishi) yozilsin. Web TelegramConnect ham parol maydonini qo'shsin.
issues.severityNote: P2 saqlandi: hujum uchun oldindan seans o'g'irligi va tasdiqlanmagan telefonli hisob kerak. authz-idor-2-3 introducedByRound3=false degan (kontrakt shunday belgilagan), lekin Telegram bog'lanishi parol tiklash kanaliga aynan Round 3 da aylangani uchun true deb baholandi.
